title_en: Krause Synchronization Transformers
title_zh: Krause同步Transformer

sentences.en: Self-attention in Transformers relies on globally normalized softmax weights, causing all tokens to compete for influence at every layer.
sentences.zh: Transformer中的自注意力依赖于全局归一化的softmax权重，导致所有词元在每一层竞争影响力。

sentences.en: When composed across depth, this interaction pattern induces strong synchronization dynamics that favor convergence toward a dominant mode, a behavior associated with representation collapse and attention sink phenomena.
sentences.zh: 当跨深度组合时，这一交互模式诱发强同步动力学，偏向收敛到优势模式，一种与表示坍缩和注意力汇聚（attention sink）现象相关的行为。

sentences.en: We introduce $\textbf{Krause Attention}$, a principled attention mechanism inspired by bounded-confidence consensus dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 $\textbf{Krause Attention}$，一个受有界置信共识动力学启发的有原则注意力机制。

sentences.en: Krause Attention replaces similarity-based global aggregation with distance-based, localized, and selectively sparse interactions, promoting structured local synchronization instead of global mixing.
sentences.zh: Krause Attention用基于距离的、局部化的、选择性稀疏交互取代基于相似性的全局聚合，促进结构化局部同步而非全局混合。

sentences.en: We relate this behavior to recent theory modeling Transformer dynamics as interacting particle systems, and show how bounded-confidence interactions naturally moderate attention concentration and alleviate attention sinks.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一行为与近期将Transformer动力学建模为相互作用粒子系统的理论联系起来，并表明有界置信交互如何自然地调和注意力集中并缓解注意力汇聚。

sentences.en: Restricting interactions to local neighborhoods also reduces runtime complexity from quadratic to linear in sequence length.
sentences.zh: 将交互限制在局部邻域，也把运行时复杂度从序列长度的二次降低到线性。

sentences.en: Empirically, we validate Krause Attention across diverse settings, including vision (ViT on CIFAR/ImageNet), autoregressive image generation (MNIST/CIFAR-10), large language models (Llama/Qwen), and language models trained from scratch at multiple scales (100M/200M).
sentences.zh: 我们从经验上在多样设置中验证了Krause Attention，包括视觉（CIFAR/ImageNet上的ViT）、自回归图像生成（MNIST/CIFAR-10）、大语言模型（Llama/Qwen），以及从零训练的多尺度语言模型（100M/200M）。

sentences.en: Across these domains, Krause Attention achieves consistent performance gains while improving computational efficiency, highlighting bounded-confidence dynamics as a scalable and effective inductive bias for attention.
sentences.zh: 在这些域中，Krause Attention在提升计算效率的同时取得了一致的性能增益，凸显了有界置信动力学作为注意力的一种可扩展且有效的归纳偏置。

sentences.en: Project page is available at https://jingkun-liu.github.io/krause-sync-transformers/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面可在 https://jingkun-liu.github.io/krause-sync-transformers/ 获取。

title_en: KromHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections with Kronecker-Product Residual Matrices
title_zh: KromHC：带Kronecker-积残差矩阵的流形约束超连接

sentences.en: The success of Hyper-Connections (HC) in neural networks (NN) has also highlighted issues related to training instability and restricted scalability.
sentences.zh: 超连接（HC）在神经网络（NN）中的成功也凸显了与训练不稳定性和受限可扩展性相关的问题。

sentences.en: The Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) mitigate these challenges by projecting the residual connection space onto a Birkhoff polytope, however, it faces two issues: 1) its iterative Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm does not always yield exactly doubly stochastic residual matrices;
sentences.zh: 流形约束超连接（mHC）通过将残差连接空间投影到Birkhoff多胞形上来缓解这些挑战，然而它面临两个问题：1）其迭代Sinkhorn-Knopp（SK）算法并非总能产生精确的双重随机残差矩阵；

sentences.en: 2) mHC incurs a prohibitive $\mathcal{O}(n^3C)$ parameter complexity with $n$ as the width of the residual stream and $C$ as the feature dimension.
sentences.zh: 2）mHC招致了 $\mathcal{O}(n^3C)$ 的令人望而却步的参数复杂度，其中 $n$ 是残差流的宽度，$C$ 是特征维度。

sentences.en: The recently proposed mHC-lite reparametrizes the residual matrix via the Birkhoff-von-Neumann theorem to guarantee double stochasticity, but also faces a factorial explosion in its parameter complexity, $\mathcal{O} \left( nC \cdot n! \right)$.
sentences.zh: 新近提出的mHC-lite通过Birkhoff-von-Neumann定理重新参数化残差矩阵以保证双重随机性，但也面临其参数复杂度的阶乘爆炸：$\mathcal{O} \left( nC \cdot n! \right)$。

sentences.en: To address both challenges, we propose **KromHC**, which uses the $\underline{\text{Kro}}$necker products of smaller doubly stochastic matrices to parametrize the residual matrix in $\underline{\text{mHC}}$.
sentences.zh: 为应对这两个挑战，我们提出了**KromHC**，它使用更小的双重随机矩阵的\underline{\text{Kro}}necker积来参数化\underline{\text{mHC}}中的残差矩阵。

sentences.en: By enforcing manifold constraints across the factor residual matrices along each mode of the tensorized residual stream, KromHC guarantees exact double stochasticity of the residual matrices while reducing parameter complexity to only $\mathcal{O}(n^2C)$.
sentences.zh: 通过沿张量化残差流的每个模态对因子残差矩阵强制执行流形约束，KromHC保证了残差矩阵的精确双重随机性，同时将参数复杂度降低到仅 $\mathcal{O}(n^2C)$。

sentences.en: Experiments show that KromHC matches or even outperforms other state-of-the-art (SOTA) mHC variants, while requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，KromHC匹配甚至超越了其他最先进（SOTA）的mHC变体，同时需要明显更少的可训练参数。

sentences.en: The code is at https://github.com/wz1119/KromHC.
sentences.zh: 代码位于 https://github.com/wz1119/KromHC。

title_en: Kronecker Generative Networks: A General Neural Architecture for Parameter-Efficient Learning Across Classification Tasks
title_zh: Kronecker生成式网络：跨分类任务参数高效学习的一般神经架构

sentences.en: Modern neural networks derive much of their effectiveness from rich connectivity patterns.
sentences.zh: 现代神经网络的有效性很大程度源于丰富的连接模式。

sentences.en: Yet, existing architectures often fix the topology at either the sparse or dense extremes, thereby limiting structural flexibility and analysis.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有架构往往将拓扑固定在稀疏或稠密的极端，从而限制了结构灵活性和分析。

sentences.en: We propose Kronecker Generative Networks (KGNs), an algebraic framework that constructs neural network topologies via recursive generation rules, treating topology as a first-class design object.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了Kronecker生成式网络（KGNs），一个通过递归生成规则构建神经网络拓扑的代数框架，将拓扑视为一等设计对象。

sentences.en: KGNs generate families of directed acyclic graphs with controllable connectivity complexity, enabling systematic interpolation between sparse and dense aggregation regimes.
sentences.zh: KGNs生成具有可控连接复杂性的有向无环图族，使得能够在稀疏与稠密聚合机制之间系统插值。

sentences.en: Under this formulation, architectures such as FractalNet and DenseNet arise as specific instantiations corresponding to different generation rules.
sentences.zh: 在这一公式下，诸如FractalNet和DenseNet等架构作为对应不同生成规则的特定实例出现。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis of acyclicity, connectivity scaling, and expressiveness, and demonstrate experimentally that KGN instantiations achieve favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple domains.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了对无环性、连接扩展性和表达力的理论分析，并在实验上证明KGN实例在多个域中实现了有利的准确率-效率权衡。

title_en: KUMA: A Novel Framework with Koopman Separation and Efficient Multilevel Extraction in Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: KUMA：时间序列预测中带Koopman分离与高效多级提取的新颖框架

sentences.en: Time series forecasting plays a crucial role in a wide range of real-world applications and has become increasingly complex with the growth of multivariate dimensions and extended historical observations, leading to the prosperity of deep forecasting models.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测在广泛的现实世界应用中发挥着关键作用，并随着多变量维度和扩展历史观测的增长而变得越来越复杂，促成了深度预测模型的繁荣。

sentences.en: Previous models are hindered by three major challenges: high computational complexity, inefficient token utilization caused by redundancy and scarcity, and temporal distribution shifts resulting from non-stationary dynamics.
sentences.zh: 先前模型受到三大挑战的阻碍：高计算复杂度、由冗余和稀缺引起的低效词元利用，以及由非平稳动力学引发的时间分布偏移。

sentences.en: Inspired by Koopman theory and the success of multilevel encoder–decoder architectures with skip connections, we design an input-dependent Koopman module to decompose time series into Koopman dynamics and residual dynamics.
sentences.zh: 受Koopman理论和带跳跃连接的多级编码器-解码器架构成功的启发，我们设计了一个输入依赖的Koopman模块，将时间序列分解为Koopman动力学和残差动力学。

sentences.en: Building upon this formulation, we propose a U-shaped Multilevel Attention module (UMA) that integrates element-wise attention filtering and linear attention, giving rise to KUMA.
sentences.zh: 基于这一公式，我们提出了一个U形多级注意力模块（UMA），它集成逐元素注意力过滤和线性注意力，从而产生KUMA。

sentences.en: The input-dependent Koopman operator mitigates the issue of operator mixture and alleviates temporal distribution shifts, while UMA achieves a favorable balance between token redundancy and token scarcity with acceptable computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 输入依赖的Koopman算子缓解了算子混合问题并减轻了时间分布偏移，而UMA以可接受的计算效率在词元冗余与词元稀缺之间实现了有利的平衡。

sentences.en: Comprehensive evaluations across 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate that KUMA achieves superior performance compared to existing excellent approaches.
sentences.zh: 跨12个基准数据集的全面评估表明，相较现有优秀方法，KUMA实现了优越的性能。

title_en: Kuramoto Oscillatory Phase Encoding: Neuro-inspired Synchronization for Improved Learning Efficiency
title_zh: Kuramoto振荡相位编码：用于提高学习效率的神经启发同步

sentences.en: Spatiotemporal neural dynamics and oscillatory synchronization are widely implicated in biological information processing and have been hypothesized to support flexible coordination such as feature binding.
sentences.zh: 时空神经动力学和振荡同步被广泛认为参与生物信息处理，并已被假设支持诸如特征捆绑等灵活协调。

sentences.en: By contrast, most deep learning architectures represent and propagate information through activation values, neglecting the joint dynamics of rate and phase.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大多数深度学习架构通过激活值表示和传播信息，忽视了速率与相位的联合动力学。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Kuramoto oscillatory Phase Encoding (KoPE) as an additional, evolving phase state to Vision Transformers, incorporating a neuro-inspired synchronization mechanism to advance learning efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将Kuramoto振荡相位编码（KoPE）作为额外、演化的相位状态引入Vision Transformer中，融入神经启发的同步机制以推进学习效率。

sentences.en: We show that KoPE can improve training, parameter, and data efficiency of vision models through synchronization-enhanced structure learning.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，KoPE能够通过同步增强的结构学习，改善视觉模型的训练、参数和数据效率。

sentences.en: Moreover, KoPE benefits tasks requiring structured understanding, including semantic and panoptic segmentation, representation alignment with language, and few-shot abstract visual reasoning (ARC-AGI).
sentences.zh: 此外，KoPE使需要结构化理解的任务受益，包括语义和全景分割、与语言的表示对齐，以及少样本抽象视觉推理（ARC-AGI）。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis and empirical verification further suggest that KoPE can accelerate attention concentration for learning efficiency.
sentences.zh: 理论分析和实证验证进一步表明，KoPE能够为学习效率加速注意力集中。

sentences.en: These results indicate that synchronization can serve as a scalable, neuro-inspired mechanism for advancing state-of-the-art neural network models.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，同步可以充当一种可扩展的、神经启发的机制，用于推进最先进的神经网络模型。

title_en: L-CUBE: Isolating Long-Context Capacity from Knowledge with Controllable Mutual Information Scaling
title_zh: L-CUBE：通过可控互信息缩放将长上下文能力与知识分离

sentences.en: Evaluating long-context language models on natural language conflates architectural capacity to capture dependencies with semantic knowledge and vocabulary statistics.
sentences.zh: 在自然语言上评估长上下文语言模型，将捕获依赖的架构能力与语义知识和词汇统计混为一谈。

sentences.en: When models fail at long contexts, we cannot determine whether failures stem from fundamental architectural limitations or insufficient domain knowledge, preventing clean diagnosis of efficient architectures before expensive training on real data.
sentences.zh: 当模型在长上下文上失败时，我们无法确定失败源于根本的架构局限还是领域知识不足，这使得在真实数据上进行昂贵训练之前，无法对高效架构进行干净的诊断。

sentences.en: We introduce **L-CUBE** (Long-Context Utilization Benchmark), a synthetic benchmark that isolates dependency-capturing capacity from semantic knowledge through hierarchical Gaussian sequences with controllable bipartite mutual information scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了**L-CUBE**（长上下文利用基准），一个通过可控二部互信息缩放的层级Gaussian序列，将捕获依赖的能力与语义知识分离的合成基准。

sentences.en: The generator provides exact ground-truth conditionals that scale efficiently to arbitrarily long sequences, enabling unconfounded evaluation via conditional KL divergence rather than perplexity alone.
sentences.zh: 该生成器提供精确的真值条件，可高效扩展到任意长序列，使得能够通过条件KL散度而非仅困惑度进行无混杂的评估。

sentences.en: We define *long-context utilization* to measure the amount of available predictive information that models extract as context grows.
sentences.zh: 我们定义*长上下文利用*，以度量模型随着上下文增长所提取的可用预测信息量。

sentences.en: Experiments across transformers, state space models, and efficient alternatives validate L²M capacity theory predictions and uncover new phenomena.
sentences.zh: 跨transformer、状态空间模型和高效替代方案的实验验证了L²M能力理论的预测，并揭示了新现象。

sentences.en: L-CUBE enables practitioners to test whether a particular design will maintain long-context capability at target sequence lengths before committing to real-data training.
sentences.zh: L-CUBE使实践者能够在投入真实数据训练之前，测试特定设计在目标序列长度上能否保持长上下文能力。

title_en: L-Drive: Beyond a Single Mapping—Latent Context Drives Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: L-Drive：超越单一映射——潜在上下文驱动时间序列预测

sentences.en: Mainstream methods for multivariate time-series forecasting largely follow the Direct-Mapping paradigm.
sentences.zh: 多变量时间序列预测的主流方法大多遵循直接映射范式。

sentences.en: They learn a unified mapping from history to the future in the observation space to fit value-level dependencies.
sentences.zh: 它们在观测空间中学习从历史到未来的统一映射，以拟合值级依赖。

sentences.en: However, real-world systems often undergo distribution shifts and regime changes.
sentences.zh: 然而，现实世界系统往往经历分布偏移和机制变化。

sentences.en: In such cases, a unified mapping can exhibit response lag around turning points, causing error accumulation within the switching window and reducing forecasting reliability.
sentences.zh: 在此类情况下，统一映射可能在转折点附近表现出响应滞后，导致切换窗口内的误差积累并降低预测可靠性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose L-Drive, a change-aware forecasting framework.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了L-Drive，一个变化感知的预测框架。

sentences.en: L-Drive introduces a Latent-Context, to explicitly characterize high-level dynamics evolving over time, and uses gating to modulate increment representations.
sentences.zh: L-Drive引入一个潜在上下文（Latent-Context），以显式刻画随时间演变的高层动力学，并使用门控调制增量表示。

sentences.en: This provides more timely change cues and improves adaptation to changing segments.
sentences.zh: 这提供了更及时的变化线索，并改善了对变化片段的适应。

sentences.en: In addition, it incorporates patch-shared relative positional basis functions to strengthen intra-segment structural modeling and reduce overfitting caused by absolute-position memorization.
sentences.zh: 此外，它纳入patch共享的相对位置基函数，以加强段内结构建模并减少由绝对位置记忆引起的过拟合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of L-Drive and show a better overall trade-off between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了L-Drive的有效性，并显示了预测准确率与计算效率之间更好的整体权衡。

title_en: L-SR1: Learned Symmetric-Rank-One Preconditioning
title_zh: L-SR1：学得的对称秩一预处理

sentences.en: End-to-end deep learning has achieved impressive results but often relies on large labeled datasets, exhibits limited generalization to unseen scenarios, and incurs substantial computational cost.
sentences.zh: 端到端深度学习取得了令人印象深刻的成果，但往往依赖大型带标签数据集，对未见场景的泛化有限，并招致大量计算成本。

sentences.en: Classical optimization methods, in contrast, are more data-efficient and lightweight but frequently suffer from slow convergence.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，经典优化方法更具数据效率且轻量，但常常遭受缓慢收敛。

sentences.en: Learned optimizers aim to bridge this gap, yet existing approaches have focused primarily on first-order methods, while learned second-order optimization has received much less attention.
sentences.zh: 学得优化器旨在弥合这一差距，然而现有方法主要聚焦于一阶方法，而学得的二阶优化受到的关注则少得多。

sentences.en: We introduce L-SR1, a learned second-order optimizer inspired by the classical Symmetric Rank-One (SR1) method.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了L-SR1，一个受经典对称秩一（SR1）方法启发的学得二阶优化器。

sentences.en: At its core, L-SR1 employs a Projection-Guided Secant Mechanism (PGSM) that generates positive semi-definite preconditioners and biases meta-training toward the quasi-Newton secant relation.
sentences.zh: 其核心，L-SR1采用一个投影引导割线机制（PGSM），它生成半正定预处理算子，并将元训练偏向拟Newton割线关系。

sentences.en: Through controlled analytic benchmarks, we study stability, generalization across problem dimensions, and search direction quality, and further evaluate L-SR1 on Monocular Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), where it outperforms both classical and learned optimization-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 通过受控分析基准，我们研究稳定性、跨问题维度的泛化以及搜索方向质量，并进一步在单目人体网格恢复（HMR）上评估L-SR1，在那里它优于经典和基于学习优化器的基线。

sentences.en: With a compact model and no reliance on task-specific fine-tuning or annotated data, L-SR1 demonstrates strong generalization and can be integrated into a broad range of iterative optimization problems to accelerate convergence and reduce the required number of iterations.
sentences.zh: 借助紧凑模型且不依赖任务特定微调或标注数据，L-SR1展现出强泛化能力，并可集成到广泛的迭代优化问题中以加速收敛并减少所需迭代次数。

title_en: L2G-NET: Local to Global Spectral Graph Neural Networks via Cauchy Factorizations
title_zh: L2G-NET：通过Cauchy因式分解的从局部到全局谱图神经网络

sentences.en: Despite their theoretical advantages, spectral methods based on the graph Fourier transform (GFT) are seldom used in graph neural networks (GNNs) due to the cost of computing the eigenbasis and the lack of vertex-domain locality in spectral representations.
sentences.zh: 尽管具有理论优势，基于图傅里叶变换（GFT）的谱方法在图神经网络（GNNs）中很少使用，原因在于计算特征基的成本以及谱表示缺乏顶点域局部性。

sentences.en: As a result, most GNNs rely on local approximations such as polynomial Laplacian filters or message passing, which limit their ability to model long-range dependencies.
sentences.zh: 因此，大多数GNN依赖诸如多项式Laplacian滤波器或消息传递等局部近似，这限制了它们建模长距离依赖的能力。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce a novel factorization of the GFT into operators acting on subgraphs, which are then combined via a sequence of Cauchy matrices.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了GFT的一种新颖因式分解，将其分解为作用于子图的算子，然后通过Cauchy矩阵序列进行组合。

sentences.en: We use this factorization to propose a new class of spectral GNNs, which we term L2G-Net (Local-to-Global Net).
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一因式分解提出了一类新的谱GNN，称之为L2G-Net（从局部到全局网络）。

sentences.en: Unlike existing spectral methods, which are either fully global (when they use the GFT) or local (when they use polynomial filters), L2G-Net operates by processing the spectral representations of subgraphs and then combining them via structured matrices.
sentences.zh: 与现有谱方法（它们要么在使用GFT时完全全局，要么在使用多项式滤波器时完全局部）不同，L2G-Net通过处理子图的谱表示，再经结构化矩阵组合它们来运作。

sentences.en: Our algorithm avoids full eigendecompositions, exploiting graph topology to construct the factorization with quadratic complexity in the number of nodes, scaled by the subgraph interface size.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法避免完整的特征分解，利用图拓扑以节点数量的二次复杂度（按子图接口大小缩放）构建因式分解。

sentences.en: Experiments on benchmarks stressing non-local dependencies show that L2G-Net outperforms existing spectral techniques and is competitive with the state-of-the-art with orders of magnitude fewer learnable parameters.
sentences.zh: 在强调非局部依赖的基准上的实验表明，L2G-Net优于现有谱技术，并以少数个数量级的可学习参数与最先进方法具有竞争力。

title_en: LabBuilder: Protocol-Grounded 3D Layout Generation for Interactable and Safe Laboratory
title_zh: LabBuilder：面向可交互安全实验室的协议依托3D布局生成

sentences.en: Automated laboratories hold the promise of accelerating scientific discovery, yet their deployment is bottlenecked by the difficulty of designing safe and executable environments.
sentences.zh: 自动化实验室有望加速科学发现，然而它们的部署受制于设计安全且可执行环境的困难。

sentences.en: While simulator-based design offers scalability, existing 3D scene generation methods are primarily tailored for household settings, optimizing for visual plausibility while neglecting the protocol grounding and layout-level safety constraints essential for scientific experimentation.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于模拟器的设计提供了可扩展性，现有3D场景生成方法主要针对家庭环境定制，优化视觉合理性，却忽视了科学实验所必需的协议依托和布局级安全约束。

sentences.en: We present LabBuilder, an end-to-end system that generates and verifies 3D laboratory layouts from concise textual specifications.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LabBuilder，一个从简洁文本规格生成并验证3D实验室布局的端到端系统。

sentences.en: It operates through three tightly coupled components: LabForge first curates a meta-dataset of annotated assets and chemical knowledge, translating natural language specifications into structured protocols; building on these protocols, LabGen synthesizes laboratory layouts via an iterative, constraint-aware optimization strategy; finally, LabTouchstone evaluates the resulting layouts as a unified benchmark.
sentences.zh: 它通过三个紧密耦合的组件运行：LabForge首先策划一个带注释资产和化学知识的元数据集，将自然语言规格转化为结构化协议；基于这些协议，LabGen通过迭代的、约束感知的优化策略合成实验室布局；最后，LabTouchstone将所得布局作为一个统一基准进行评估。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LabBuilder significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, producing laboratory environments that are realistic and valid under modeled geometric, chemical-safety, and navigation constraints.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LabBuilder显著优于现有最先进方法，在建模的几何、化学安全和导航约束下，产生了现实且有效的实验室环境。

title_en: Label-Guided Representation Learning for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Classification
title_zh: 面向不完整多视图多标签分类的标签引导表示学习

sentences.en: Incomplete multi-view multi-label classification addresses scenarios where views and labels are partially missing.
sentences.zh: 不完整多视图多标签分类处理视图和标签部分缺失的场景。

sentences.en: While existing methods treat labels solely as supervision signals, they overlook the semantic structure inherent in partial annotations.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法仅将标签视为监督信号，它们忽视了部分标注中固有的语义结构。

sentences.en: We propose Label-Guided Representation Learning (LGRL) that systematically exploits label semantics as structural priors throughout learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了标签引导表示学习（LGRL），它在整个学习过程中系统性地利用标签语义作为结构先验。

sentences.en: Our framework constructs a semantic-informed mixture prior via learnable category prototypes to guide representation extraction, and introduces category-specific conditional posteriors where prototypes act as Bayesian experts for multi-view fusion.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架通过可学习的类别原型构建一个语义感知的混合先验来引导表示提取，并引入类别特定的条件后验，其中原型充当多视图融合的Bayesian专家。

sentences.en: We further derive a principled label-driven information bottleneck objective balancing reconstruction sufficiency with cross-view consistency, enabling category-conditional reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步推导出一个有原则的标签驱动信息瓶颈目标，它在重建充分性与跨视图一致性之间取得平衡，支持类别条件推理。

sentences.en: Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of LGRL across benchmark datasets as well as real-world applications in sports analytics and medical imaging.
sentences.zh: 大量实验结果证明了LGRL在基准数据集以及运动分析和医学成像等现实世界应用中的有效性。

title_en: LABO: LLM-Accelerated Bayesian Optimization through Broad Exploration and Selective Experimentation
title_zh: LABO：通过广泛探索与选择性实验加速LLM的Bayesian优化

sentences.en: The high cost and data scarcity in scientific exploration have motivated the use of large language models (LLMs) as knowledge-driven components in Bayesian optimization (BO).
sentences.zh: 科学探索中的高成本和数据稀缺，推动了将大语言模型（LLMs）用作Bayesian优化（BO）中知识驱动组件的动机。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches typically embed LLMs directly into the sampling or surrogate modeling pipeline, without fully leveraging their significantly lower evaluation cost compared to real-world experiments.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常将LLM直接嵌入采样或代理建模流水线，而未能充分利用其相比现实世界实验显著更低的评估成本。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose LLM-Accelerated Bayesian Optimization (LABO), a framework that combines LLM predictions with experimental observations within a single BO loop.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出了LLM加速Bayesian优化（LABO），一个在单一BO循环内结合LLM预测与实验观测的框架。

sentences.en: LABO employs a gating mechanism to dynamically balance reliance on LLM predictions versus actual experiments.
sentences.zh: LABO采用一个门控机制，动态平衡对LLM预测与实际实验的依赖。

sentences.en: By leveraging inexpensive LLM evaluations to broadly explore the search space and reserving costly real experiments only for regions with high uncertainty, LABO achieves more sample-efficient optimization.
sentences.zh: 通过利用廉价的LLM评估广泛探索搜索空间，并仅为高不确定性区域保留昂贵真实实验，LABO实现了更样本高效的优化。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis with a cumulative regret bound that formalizes this efficiency gain.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一个带有累积遗憾界的理论分析，形式化了这一效率增益。

sentences.en: Empirical results across diverse scientific tasks demonstrate that LABO consistently outperforms existing methods under identical experimental budgets.
sentences.zh: 跨多样科学任务的实证结果表明，在相同的实验预算下，LABO一致优于现有方法。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that LABO offers a practical and theoretically grounded approach for integrating LLMs into scientific discovery workflows.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，LABO为将LLM集成到科学发现工作流中提供了一种实用且理论依托的方法。

title_en: LAGEA: Language Guided Embodied Agents for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: LAGEA：用于机器人操作的语言引导具身智能体

sentences.en: Robotic manipulation benefits from foundation models that describe goals, but today's agents still lack a principled way to learn from their own mistakes.
sentences.zh: 机器人操作受益于描述目标的基础模型，但当今的智能体仍然缺乏从自身错误中学习的有原则方式。

sentences.en: We ask whether natural language can serve as feedback, an error-reasoning signal that helps embodied agents diagnose what went wrong and correct course.
sentences.zh: 我们追问，自然语言能否充当反馈——一种帮助具身智能体诊断出错之处并纠偏的错误推理信号。

sentences.en: We introduce LAGEA (Language Guided Embodied Agents), a framework that turns episodic, schema-constrained reflections from a vision language model (VLM) into temporally grounded guidance for reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了LAGEA（语言引导具身智能体），一个将来自视觉语言模型（VLM）的episodic、受schema约束反思转化为强化学习时间依托指导的框架。

sentences.en: LAGEA summarizes each attempt in concise language, localizes the decisive moments in the trajectory, aligns feedback with visual state in a shared representation, and converts goal progress and feedback agreement into bounded, step-wise shaping rewardswhose influence is modulated by an adaptive, failure-aware coefficient.
sentences.zh: LAGEA以简洁语言总结每次尝试，定位轨迹中的决定性时刻，在共享表示中将反馈与视觉状态对齐，并将目标进展与反馈一致性转化为有界的、逐步塑形奖励，其影响力由一个自适应的失败感知系数调制。

sentences.en: This design yields dense signals early when exploration needs direction and gracefully recedes as competence grows.
sentences.zh: 这一设计在探索需要方向的早期产生密集信号，并随能力增长优雅地减弱。

sentences.en: On the Meta-World MT10 and Robotic Fetch embodied manipulation benchmarks, LAGEA improves average success over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods by 9.0% on random goals, 5.3% on fixed goals, and 17% on fetch tasks, while converging faster.
sentences.zh: 在Meta-World MT10和Robotic Fetch具身操作基准上，LAGEA在随机目标上将平均成功率相较于最先进（SOTA）方法提高了9.0%，在固定目标上提高5.3%，在fetch任务上提高17%，同时收敛更快。

sentences.en: These results support our hypothesis: language, when structured and grounded in time, is an effective mechanism for teaching robots to self-reflect on mistakes and make better choices.
sentences.zh: 这些结果支持我们的假设：语言在结构化并及时依托时，是教会机器人反思错误并做出更好选择的用于机制。

sentences.en: Code will be released soon.
sentences.zh: 代码即将发布。

title_en: LagLLM: LLM-empowered lead–lag dependency learning for spatial-temporal time series forecasting
title_zh: LagLLM：时空时间序列预测的LLM赋能领先-滞后依赖学习

sentences.en: Spatial-temporal time series forecasting is challenging due to complex lead-lag dependencies, which are often ignored or inadequately modeled by existing methods.
sentences.zh: 时空时间序列预测因复杂的领先-滞后依赖而具有挑战性，这些依赖往往被现有方法忽视或建模不足。

sentences.en: Thus, we propose LagLLM, the first LLM-empowered framework that explicitly models lead–lag dependencies by unifying data-driven dynamics modeling and knowledge-driven semantic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了LagLLM，第一个通过统一数据驱动动力学建模与知识驱动语义推理来显式建模领先-滞后依赖的LLM赋能框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, LagLLM constructs a lead-lag graph by integrating learnable embeddings, spatial proximity, and prompt-guided reasoning from a frozen LLM, which can capture lead-lag dependencies informed by the underlying data structure and semantic knowledge.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LagLLM通过集成可学习嵌入、空间邻近性和来自冻结LLM的提示引导推理来构建一个领先-滞后图，它能够捕获以底层数据结构和语义知识为依据的领先-滞后依赖。

sentences.en: In addition, LagLLM introduces structural token sorting based on the graph, which can make a fine-tuned LLM explicitly perceive directional and delayed interactions.
sentences.zh: 此外，LagLLM引入基于该图的结构化词元排序，这能使微调后的LLM显式地感知方向性和延迟交互。

sentences.en: Experiments on eight real-world datasets show that LagLLM achieves the state-of-the-art performance with improved accuracy, robustness, and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 在八个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，LagLLM以改进的准确率、鲁棒性和可解释性取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/w2obin/LagLLM-2026.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/w2obin/LagLLM-2026 获取。

title_en: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies
title_zh: Lagrangian扰动扩散引导：生成式策略的潜在强化学习

sentences.en: Behavior cloning with high-capacity generative policies achieves strong imitation performance, but is often limited by demonstration coverage and distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 使用高容量生成式策略的行为克隆实现了强模仿性能，但往往受限于演示覆盖率和分布偏移。

sentences.en: Direct reinforcement learning fine-tuning can improve performance, but updating large action decoders is frequently unstable and sample inefficient.
sentences.zh: 直接强化学习微调可以提升性能，但更新大动作解码器经常不稳定且样本效率低。

sentences.en: We propose **Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering (LP-DS)**, a lightweight adaptation method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning a compact noise-space perturbation before decoding.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**Lagrangian扰动扩散引导（LP-DS）**，一种轻量级适配方法，它通过在学习一个紧凑的噪声空间扰动（在解码之前）来改进一个冻结的生成式策略。

sentences.en: LP-DS optimizes this perturbation with a Lagrangian trust-region objective, improving downstream value while constraining deviation from the latent prior.
sentences.zh: LP-DS用一个Lagrangian信任域目标优化该扰动，在约束对潜在先验偏差的同时改进下游价值。

sentences.en: Across RoboMimic manipulation, OpenAI Gym locomotion, and Adroit dexterous manipulation benchmarks, LP-DS improves sample efficiency, success, and return while maintaining higher action-space entropy than unconstrained noise-space steering, with return improvements of up to 25\% over prior baselines.
sentences.zh: 在RoboMimic操作、OpenAI Gym运动以及Adroit灵巧操作基准上，LP-DS在保持比无约束噪声空间引导更高的动作空间熵的同时，改进了样本效率、成功率和回报，相较先前基线的回报改进最高达25\%。

sentences.en: Additional evaluations with flow-matching backbones, a large vision-language-action model, and physical Franka deployment show that LP-DS is not limited to compact diffusion policies or simulated benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 使用流匹配骨干、一个大型视觉-语言-动作模型以及真实Franka部署的附加评估表明，LP-DS并不局限于紧凑扩散策略或模拟基准。

sentences.en: Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home.
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home。

title_en: LakeQA: An Exploratory QA Benchmark over a Million-Scale Data Lake
title_zh: LakeQA：百万级数据湖上的探索性问答基准

sentences.en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown rapid progress on reading-based question answering (QA), where the evidence is explicitly provided or trivially retrievable.
sentences.zh: 近期的大语言模型（LLMs）在基于阅读的问答（QA）上显示出快速进展，其中证据被显式提供或可轻易获取。

sentences.en: In contrast, real-world questions are often not paired with accurate evidence documents.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，现实世界的问题往往没有配对的准确证据文档。

sentences.en: The useful evidence resides in a massive collection of data lakes, necessitating searching as a prerequisite for answering.
sentences.zh: 有用证据位于海量的数据湖集合中，使搜索成为回答的前提条件。

sentences.en: However, there is a lack of a comprehensive benchmark that requires searching and reasoning over a large collection of data lakes.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前缺乏一个需要在大型数据湖集合上进行搜索和推理的全面基准。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce LakeQA, a  comprehensive benchmark for search-centric question answering over data lakes that jointly emphasizes \emph{searching} and \emph{reasoning} capabilities.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了LakeQA，一个面向数据湖上以搜索为中心的问答的全面基准，它联合强调\emph{搜索}和\emph{推理}能力。

sentences.en: LakeQA is built on a heterogeneous collection of ~9.5 TB text resources from Wikipedia and open-source government data, spanning structured and unstructured data.
sentences.zh: LakeQA构建于一个来自Wikipedia和开源政府数据、约9.5 TB文本资源的异构集合之上，涵盖结构化和非结构化数据。

sentences.en: To ensure the quality of LakeQA's tasks, each sample is annotated by at least one Ph.D level expert.
sentences.zh: 为确保LakeQA任务的质量，每个样本由至少一位博士级专家标注。

sentences.en: Each task requires long-horizon multi-hop reasoning with implicit intermediate steps: agents need to discover the correct document(s) and then compose evidence across sources to produce the answer.
sentences.zh: 每个任务都需要具有隐式中间步骤的长时域多跳推理：智能体需要发现正确的文档，然后跨来源组合证据以产生答案。

sentences.en: Intensive experiment results on seven frontier LLMs have demonstrated that LakeQA is challenging.
sentences.zh: 在七个前沿LLM上进行的大量实验结果已证明LakeQA具有挑战性。

sentences.en: For instance, GPT-5.2 only obtains an exact matching score of 14.73% on LakeQA.
sentences.zh: 例如，GPT-5.2在LakeQA上仅获得14.73%的精确匹配分数。

sentences.en: Overall LakeQA provides a realistic testbed for developing LLM agents that can both \emph{find} and \emph{analyze} data in modern data lakes.
sentences.zh: 总体上，LakeQA为开发既能\emph{发现}又能\emph{分析}现代数据湖中数据的LLM智能体提供了一个现实的试验台。

title_en: LALM-as-a-Judge: Benchmarking Large Audio-Language Models for Safety Evaluation in Multi-Turn Spoken Dialogues
title_zh: LALM-as-a-Judge：对多轮口语对话中安全评估的大型音频-语言模型进行基准测试

sentences.en: Evaluation of socially unsafe content in spoken dialogues remains text-centric, missing prosody and transcription failures.
sentences.zh: 对口语对话中社交不安全内容的评估仍以文本为中心，遗漏了韵律和转录失败。

sentences.en: We present LALM-as-a-Judge, which includes an open benchmark of 24,000 multi-turn spoken dialogues with one localized unsafe turn, generated out of 8 socially unsafe categories and 5 severity levels.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LALM-as-a-Judge，它包含一个开放的基准，含24,000个多轮口语对话，每个对话有一个本地化的不安全轮次，由8个社交不安全类别和5个严重程度级别生成。

sentences.en: We evaluate 6 large audio-language models (LALMs) as judges, open and closed-source, in text-only, audio-only, and multimodal setups by their sensitivity, severity-order specificity, and turn-position bias for socially harmful content in the dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我们将6个大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）作为评判者，涵盖开源和闭源，在纯文本、纯音频和多模态设置中进行评估，依据它们对对话中社交有害内容的敏感性、严重程度顺序特异性以及轮次位置偏差。

sentences.en: Results show that audio contributes non-lexical evidence beyond transcript semantics and that multimodal gains are not universal but can be text-anchored, balanced, conservative, and interfering, which we link to the audio pathway bottlenecks and fusion limits.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，音频提供了超越转录语义的非词汇证据，而多模态增益并非普遍存在，可能表现为文本锚定、均衡、保守和干扰四种类型，我们将其与音频通路瓶颈和融合限制联系起来。

sentences.en: We position the benchmark as diagnostic and derive practitioner guidance for model, modality, and prompts choices.
sentences.zh: 我们将该基准定位为诊断性的，并为模型、模态和提示选择提供实践者指导。

title_en: LAMP: Data-Efficient Linear Affine Weight-Space Models for Parameter-Controlled 3D Shape Generation and Extrapolation
title_zh: LAMP：用于参数控制3D形状生成与外推的数据高效线性仿射权重空间模型

sentences.en: Generating high-fidelity 3D geometries under explicit parameter constraints is central to engineering design, yet current methods often require large datasets and fail to provide reliable control beyond the training distribution.
sentences.zh: 在显式参数约束下生成高保真3D几何对工程设计至关重要，然而当前方法往往需要大型数据集，并且无法在训练分布之外提供可靠控制。

sentences.en: We introduce LAMP, a data-efficient framework for controllable and interpretable 3D generation that aligns signed distance function (SDF) decoders by overfitting each exemplar from a shared initialization, then generates new designs by solving a parameter-constrained affine mixing problem in the aligned weight space.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了LAMP，一个用于可控且可解释3D生成的数据高效框架，它通过从共享初始化过拟合每个样本将对符号距离函数（SDF）解码器对齐，然后通过对齐权重空间中求解一个参数约束仿射混合问题来生成新设计。

sentences.en: To improve reliability, we propose a linearity-mismatch safety metric that detects when mixed decoders leave the valid local regime.
sentences.zh: 为提升可靠性，我们提出一个线性失配安全指标，它检测混合解码器何时离开有效局部机制。

sentences.en: We evaluate LAMP on DrivAerNet++, BlendedNet, and additional industry-level vehicle families, including sports cars, SUVs, and convertibles.
sentences.zh: 我们在DrivAerNet++、BlendedNet以及其他行业级车辆族（包括跑车、SUV和敞篷车）上评估LAMP。

sentences.en: LAMP enables controlled interpolation with as few as 50 samples, safe extrapolation up to 100\% beyond training ranges, and performance-guided optimization under fixed parameters, outperforming conditional autoencoder and Deep Network Interpolation (DNI) baselines in extrapolation, data efficiency, and parameter fidelity.
sentences.zh: LAMP在少至50个样本下实现受控插值，在超过训练范围高达100\%时实现安全外推，并在固定参数下进行性能引导优化，在外推、数据效率和参数保真度方面优于条件自编码器和深度网络插值（DNI）基线。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that LAMP advances controllable, data-efficient, and safe 3D generation for design exploration, dataset generation, and performance-driven optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，LAMP为设计探索、数据集生成和性能驱动优化推进了可控、数据高效且安全的3D生成。

title_en: Landmark-Guided Policy Optimization for Multi-Objective Language Model Selection
title_zh: 用于多目标语言模型选择的地标引导策略优化

sentences.en: Selecting a pretrained large language model (LLM) to fine-tune for a task-specific dataset can be time-consuming and costly.
sentences.zh: 为任务特定数据集选择要微调的预训练大语言模型（LLM），可能耗时且成本高昂。

sentences.en: With several candidate models available to choose from, varying in size, architecture, and pretraining data, finding the best model for a specific task often involves extensive trial and error.
sentences.zh: 在多个候选模型（规模、架构和预训练数据各异）可供选择的情况下，为特定任务寻找最佳模型往往涉及大量的反复试验。

sentences.en: In addition, the "best" model may not necessarily be the one with the lowest test loss, as practical considerations such as deployment costs, inference throughput, and limited search budgets might also play crucial roles.
sentences.zh: 此外，“最佳”模型未必是测试损失最低的那个，因为部署成本、推断吞吐量和有限的搜索预算等实际考虑也可能起关键作用。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce LAMPS (LAnguage Model Pareto Selection), a novel and open-source multi-objective AutoML framework that meta-learns a resource allocation policy to efficiently identify (or approximate) the Pareto front of candidate LLMs for a task-specific dataset.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了LAMPS（语言模型Pareto选择），一个新颖的开源多目标AutoML框架，它元学习一个资源分配策略，以高效识别（或近似）任务特定数据集候选LLM的Pareto前沿。

sentences.en: It is based on two key ideas: (1) landmark fine-tuning, which generates early performance indicators of the candidate models, and (2) meta-learning via reinforcement learning, which learns an effective selection policy from historical performance data (a meta-dataset).
sentences.zh: 它基于两个关键思想：（1）地标微调，它生成候选模型的早期性能指标；（2）通过强化学习进行元学习，它从历史性能数据（元数据集）中学习有效的选择策略。

sentences.en: Our results show that, on held-out datasets, LAMPS reduces search time by an average of 73% compared to exhaustive search, while still covering more than 99% of the optimal target space hypervolume.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，在保留数据集上，相较穷举搜索，LAMPS平均将搜索时间减少了73%，同时仍覆盖了最优目标空间超体积的99%以上。

title_en: Langevin Rollout Optimization for Modelic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用于Modelic强化学习的Langevin展开优化

sentences.en: Planning-driven model-based (modelic) reinforcement learning has achieved impressive success in continuous control tasks but predominantly relies on zero-order optimizers like Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI).
sentences.zh: 规划驱动的基于模型（modelic）强化学习在连续控制任务中取得了令人印象深刻的成功，但主要依赖诸如Model Predictive Path Integral（MPPI）等零阶优化器。

sentences.en: While robust for global exploration, MPPI updates actions solely through sampling and neglects the smooth return gradients inherent in structured dynamics that guide fine-grained search.
sentences.zh: 虽然对于全局探索鲁棒，MPPI仅通过采样更新动作，忽视了引导细粒度搜索的结构化动力学中固有的平滑回报梯度。

sentences.en: To complement MPPI’s robustness with gradient-guided precision, we first propose \textbf{La}ngevin \textbf{R}ollout \textbf{O}ptimization (LaRO), which leverages return gradients to refine actions via Langevin dynamics, achieving reliable local convergence without sacrificing multimodal exploration.
sentences.zh: 为用梯度引导的精度补充MPPI的鲁棒性，我们首先提出\textbf{La}ngevin \textbf{R}ollout \textbf{O}ptimization（LaRO），它利用回报梯度通过Langevin动力学精化动作，在不牺牲多模态探索的情况下实现可靠的局部收敛。

sentences.en: This is supported by a score-augmented world model that jointly learns dynamics and a score function within a unified latent space, facilitating efficient and accurate gradient estimation for real-time planning.
sentences.zh: 这由一个分数增强世界模型支持，它在统一潜在空间内联合学习动力学和分数函数，为实时规划促进高效且准确的梯度估计。

sentences.en: Second, we combine MPPI and LaRO through a simple yet effective choice mechanism, termed \textbf{M}aximum \textbf{L}ook-\textbf{A}head \textbf{P}lanning (MLAP).
sentences.zh: 其次，我们通过一个简单而有效的选择机制组合MPPI和LaRO，称之为\textbf{M}aximum \textbf{L}ook-\textbf{A}head \textbf{P}lanning（MLAP）。

sentences.en: Finally, we instantiate MLAP within the latest  BOOM algorithm, replacing its MPPI-only planner and yielding BOOM-L. Empirical results on the DeepMind Control Suite and Humanoid Bench demonstrate that BOOM-L consistently outperforms strong baselines in both sample efficiency and final performance.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在最新的BOOM算法中实例化MLAP，替换其仅MPPI的规划器，从而得到BOOM-L。在DeepMind Control Suite和Humanoid Bench上的实证结果表明，BOOM-L在样本效率和最终性能两方面都一致优于强基线。

title_en: LangForce: Bayesian Decomposition of Vision Language Action Models via Latent Action Queries
title_zh: LangForce：通过潜在动作查询对视觉-语言-动作模型进行Bayesian分解

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in robot manipulation but often struggle to generalize to new instructions or complex multi-task scenarios.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中显示出前景，但往往难以泛化到新指令或复杂多任务场景。

sentences.en: We identify a critical pathology in current training paradigms where goal-driven data collection creates a dataset bias.
sentences.zh: 我们在当前训练范式中识别出一个关键病理，其中目标驱动的数据采集造成数据集偏差。

sentences.en: In such datasets, language instructions are highly predictable from visual observations alone, causing the conditional mutual information between instructions and actions to vanish, a phenomenon we term Information Collapse.
sentences.zh: 在此类数据集中，仅凭视觉观测语言指令就高度可预测，导致指令与动作之间的条件互信息消失，我们将这一现象称为信息坍缩。

sentences.en: Consequently, models degenerate into vision-only policies that ignore language constraints.
sentences.zh: 因此，模型退化为忽略语言约束的纯视觉策略。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose LangForce, enforces instruction following via Bayesian decomposition.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了LangForce，它通过Bayesian分解强制执行指令遵循。

sentences.en: By introducing learnable Latent Action Queries, we construct a dual-branch architecture to estimate both a vision-only prior $p(a \mid v)$ and a language-conditioned posterior $\pi(a \mid v, \ell)$.
sentences.zh: 通过引入可学习的潜在动作查询，我们构建了一个双分支架构，以同时估计纯视觉先验 $p(a \mid v)$ 和语言条件后验 $\pi(a \mid v, \ell)$。

sentences.en: We then optimize the policy to maximize the conditional Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) between actions and instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们随后优化策略以最大化动作与指令之间的条件逐点互信息（PMI）。

sentences.en: This objective effectively penalizes the vision shortcut and rewards actions that explicitly explain the language command.
sentences.zh: 这一目标有效地惩罚视觉捷径，并奖励显式解释语言命令的动作。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across on three benchmarks demonstrate substantial gains, including an 11.3\% improvement on the challenging OOD SimplerEnv benchmark, validating the ability of LangForce to robustly ground language in action.
sentences.zh: 跨三个基准的大量实验展示了实质性增益，包括在具有挑战性的OOD SimplerEnv基准上改进11.3\%，验证了LangForce将语言稳健地依托到动作中的能力。

title_en: LangPrecip: Language-Aware Multimodal Precipitation Nowcasting
title_zh: LangPrecip：语言感知的多模态降水临近预报

sentences.en: Short-term precipitation nowcasting is inherently under-constrained due to limited historical observation windows: identical observations can lead to multiple plausible future trajectories, especially for extreme events.
sentences.zh: 短期降水临近预报因有限的历史观测窗口而固有地约束不足：相同的观测可能导致多个合理的未来轨迹，尤其是对极端事件而言。

sentences.en: Existing generative methods rely solely on visual features and lack explicit constraints on precipitation motion semantics, resulting in ambiguous dynamics, blurred details, and unstable predictions.
sentences.zh: 现有生成式方法仅依赖视觉特征，缺乏对降水运动语义的显式约束，导致动力学模糊、细节不清晰和预测不稳定。

sentences.en: We propose LangPrecip, the first language-guided precipitation nowcasting framework, and contribute LangPrecip-160K, a large-scale radar-text paired dataset with 160K annotated sequences.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LangPrecip，第一个语言引导的降水临近预报框架，并贡献了LangPrecip-160K，一个含160K条标注序列的大规模雷达-文本配对数据集。

sentences.en: LangPrecip addresses the under-constrained challenge by leveraging natural-language motion descriptions as explicit semantic constraints to reduce motion ambiguity and introducing a dual-path wavelet consistency unfolding decoder that enforces physical data fidelity during latent-to-pixel reconstruction.
sentences.zh: LangPrecip通过利用自然语言运动描述作为显式语义约束来减少运动歧义，并引入一个双路径小波一致性展开解码器，在潜在到像素重建期间强制执行物理数据保真度，从而应对约束不足的挑战。

sentences.en: By reformulating nowcasting as semantically constrained trajectory generation under the Rectified Flow paradigm with model-based decoder optimization, LangPrecip produces sharper and more physically consistent forecasts.
sentences.zh: 通过在Rectified Flow范式下将临近预报重构为语义约束的轨迹生成，并配以基于模型的解码器优化，LangPrecip产生更锐利且物理上更一致的预报。

sentences.en: Experiments on Swedish and MRMS benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over state-of-the-art vision-only methods, achieving over 60\% and 19\% relative gains in heavy-rainfall CSI at 80-minute lead time with enhanced spatial detail preservation.
sentences.zh: 在Swedish和MRMS基准上的实验表明，相较最先进的纯视觉方法取得了实质性改进，在80分钟提前期下重降雨CSI上实现超过60\%和19\%的相对增益，并增强了空间细节保持。

sentences.en: Dataset is available at https://github.com/UESTC-LXD/LangPrecip.
sentences.zh: 数据集可在 https://github.com/UESTC-LXD/LangPrecip 获取。

title_en: Language as a Wave Phenomenon: Semantic Phase Locking and Interference in Neural Networks
title_zh: 语言作为波动现象：神经网络中的语义相位锁定与干扰

sentences.en: In standard Transformer architectures, semantic importance is often conflated with activation magnitude, obscuring the geometric structure of latent representations.
sentences.zh: 在标准Transformer架构中，语义重要性往往与激活幅度混为一谈，遮蔽了潜在表示的几何结构。

sentences.en: To disentangle these factors, we introduce PRISM, a complex-valued architecture designed to isolate the computational role of phase.
sentences.zh: 为解耦这些因素，我们引入了PRISM，一个旨在分离相位计算作用的复值架构。

sentences.en: By enforcing a strict unit-norm constraint (|z| = 1) and replacing attention with gated harmonic convolutions, the model is encouraged to utilize subtractive interference in the frequency domain to suppress noise, rather than relying on magnitude-based gating.
sentences.zh: 通过强制执行严格的单位范数约束（|z| = 1）并用门控谐波卷积取代注意力，模型被鼓励在频域利用相减干扰来抑制噪声，而非依赖基于幅度的门控。

sentences.en: We utilize this constrained regime to study a hybrid architecture—fusing phase-based routing with standard attention—which achieves improved parameter efficiency and representation quality compared to baselines in our evaluated settings.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一受约束机制研究一种混合架构——将基于相位的路由与标准注意力融合——在我们评估的设置中，相较基线实现了改进的参数效率和表示质量。

sentences.en: Mechanistically, interventional ablations indicate that the model carries substantial task-relevant information in phase: preserving phase largely maintains performance, whereas disrupting phase causes severe degradation.
sentences.zh: 在机制上，干预消融表明模型在相位中携带大量任务相关信息：保留相位大体上维持性能，而破坏相位则导致严重退化。

sentences.en: Together, these results suggest that phase-based spectral interference is a usable computational mechanism for neural sequence modeling at the evaluated scale.
sentences.zh: 综合这些结果，它们表明基于相位的谱干扰是所评估规模下神经序列建模的一种可用计算机制。

title_en: Language Bias in LVLMs: From In-Depth Analysis to Simple and Effective Mitigation
title_zh: LVLM中的语言偏差：从深入分析到简单有效的缓解

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) extend large language models with visual understanding, but remain vulnerable to hallucination, where outputs are fluent yet inconsistent with images.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）以视觉理解扩展了大语言模型，但仍易受幻觉影响，即输出流利却与图像不一致。

sentences.en: Recent studies link this issue to language bias—the tendency of LVLMs to over-rely on text while neglecting visual inputs.
sentences.zh: 近期研究将这一问题与语言偏差联系起来——即LVLM过度依赖文本而忽视视觉输入的趋势。

sentences.en: Yet most analyses remain empirical without uncovering its underlying cause.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数分析仍是经验性的，未揭示其根本原因。

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a systematic study of language bias and identify its root in modality misalignment during training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们对语言偏差进行了系统性研究，并识别出其根源在于训练期间的模态错位。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that both Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) often prioritize textual improvements, which may cause LVLMs to overly lean toward language modeling rather than balanced multimodal understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，视觉指令调优（VIT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）往往优先考虑文本改进，这可能使LVLM过度偏向语言建模，而非平衡的多模态理解。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose two simple yet effective methods: Language Bias Regularization (LBR), which mitigates language bias through regularization during instruction tuning, and Language Bias Penalty (LBP), which penalizes language bias in the DPO training process.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了两种简单而有效的方法：语言偏差正则化（LBR），它通过指令调优期间的正则化缓解语言偏差；以及语言偏差惩罚（LBP），它在DPO训练过程中惩罚语言偏差。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
sentences.zh: LBR一致改进了超过十个通用基准的性能，而LBP显著减少了幻觉并提高了可信度。

sentences.en: LBR consistently improves performance on over ten general benchmarks, while LBP significantly reduces hallucination and improves trustworthiness.
sentences.zh: LBR一致改进了超过十个通用基准的性能，而LBP显著减少了幻觉并提高了可信度。

sentences.en: Together, these methods not only mitigate language bias but also advance the overall alignment of LVLMs, all without introducing any additional data or auxiliary models.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些方法不仅缓解了语言偏差，还推进了LVLM的整体对齐，且无需引入任何额外数据或辅助模型。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at [https://github.com/lab-klc/HAVAE](https://github.com/lab-klc/HAVAE).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已公开于 [https://github.com/lab-klc/HAVAE](https://github.com/lab-klc/HAVAE)。

title_en: Language Generation in the Limit: Complexity Barriers and Implications for Learning
title_zh: 极限中的语言生成：复杂度障碍及其学习启示

sentences.en: Kleinberg and Mullainathan showed that language generation in the limit is always possible at the level of computability: given enough positive examples, a learner can eventually generate data indistinguishable from a target language.
sentences.zh: Kleinberg和Mullainathan表明，在可计算性层面上，极限中的语言生成总是可能的：给定足够多的正例，学习者最终能够生成与目标语言不可区分的数据。

sentences.en: However, such existence results do not address feasibility.
sentences.zh: 然而，此类存在性结果并未处理可行性。

sentences.en: We study the sample complexity of language generation in the limit for several canonical classes of formal languages.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了若干经典形式语言类别在极限中的语言生成的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: Our results show that infeasibility already appears for context-free and regular languages, and persists even for strict subclasses such as locally threshold testable languages, as well as for incomparable classes such as non-erasing pattern languages, a well-studied class in the theory of language identification.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，不可行性已经出现在上下文自由和正则语言中，并且即使在诸如局部阈值可检验语言等严格子类中，以及在不具可比性的类别如非擦除模式语言（语言识别理论中一个被充分研究的类别）中，也持续存在。

sentences.en: Overall, our results establish a clear gap between the theoretical possibility of language generation in the limit and its computational feasibility.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果确立了极限中语言生成的理论可能性与其计算可行性之间的清晰差距。

title_en: Language Generation with Feedback: Queries and Mistakes
title_zh: 带反馈的语言生成：查询与犯错

sentences.en: We investigate language generation in the limit (Kleinberg & Mullainathan, 2024; Li et al., 2025) in variants where the generator receives some feedback based on its “actions.”
sentences.zh: 我们研究了极限中语言生成（Kleinberg & Mullainathan, 2024; Li et al., 2025）在生成器根据其“动作”收到某种反馈的变体下的问题。

sentences.en: We study two such variants.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了两种此类变体。

sentences.en: In the first, which is inspired by Littlestone’s model of online learning, the generator observes whether it made a mistake at each iteration.
sentences.zh: 在第一种（受Littlestone在线学习模型启发）中，生成器观察它在每次迭代是否犯错。

sentences.en: In the second, introduced by Charikar & Pabbaraju (2025a), the generator can query whether a string belongs to the target language.
sentences.zh: 在第二种（由Charikar & Pabbaraju (2025a)引入）中，生成器可以查询某个字符串是否属于目标语言。

sentences.en: Our main result is a characterization of collections that are generable with mistake feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要结果是对可通过错误反馈生成的集合族的刻画。

sentences.en: Using similar techniques, we also characterize when generation is possible in the query model with set-based generators; set-based generators have been studied in several works (Charikar & Pabbaraju, 2025a; Kalavasis et al., 2025; Kleinberg & Wei, 2025a; Li et al., 2025).
sentences.zh: 使用类似技术，我们还刻画了在基于集合的生成器的查询模型中何时可以进行生成；基于集合的生成器已在若干工作中被研究（Charikar & Pabbaraju, 2025a; Kalavasis et al., 2025; Kleinberg & Wei, 2025a; Li et al., 2025）。

sentences.en: Beyond the characterizations themselves, we derive several implications.
sentences.zh: 超越刻画本身，我们还推导出若干启示。

sentences.en: First, our results imply new closure properties for generation with mistake and query feedback.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们的结果蕴含了带犯错和查询反馈生成的新封闭性质。

sentences.en: Second, our results show that, under feedback, generation is robust to noise: it remains possible with arbitrary contamination in the adversary’s examples and with finite contamination in the feedback.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们的结果表明，在反馈下，生成对噪声鲁棒：它即使在敌手示例存在任意污染、反馈存在有限污染的情况下仍保持可能。

sentences.en: Third, our techniques also yield new sufficient and necessary conditions for generation without feedback among other implications.
sentences.zh: 第三，在其它启示中，我们的技术还为无反馈生成提供了新的充分必要条件。

title_en: Language Generation with Replay: A Learning-Theoretic View of Model Collapse
title_zh: 带重放的语言生成：模型坍缩的学习理论视角

sentences.en: As scaling laws push the training of frontier large language models (LLMs) toward ever-growing data requirements, training pipelines are approaching a regime where much of the publicly available online text may be consumed.
sentences.zh: 随着缩放定律将前沿大语言模型（LLMs）的训练推向不断增长的数据需求，训练流水线正接近这样一个机制，其中大量公开可用的在线文本可能被消耗殆尽。

sentences.en: At the same time, widespread LLM usage increases the volume of machine-generated content on the web; together, these trends raise the likelihood of generated text re-entering future training corpora, increasing the associated risk of performance degradation often called *model collapse*.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，LLM的广泛使用增加了Web上机器生成内容的数量；这些趋势共同提高了生成文本重新进入未来训练语料库的可能性，增加了常被称为*模型坍缩*的性能退化风险。

sentences.en: In practice, model developers address this concern through data cleaning, watermarking, synthetic-data policies, or, in some cases, blissful ignorance.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，模型开发者通过数据清洗、水印、合成数据策略，或某些情况下的乐天知命来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: However, the problem of model collapse in generative models has not been examined from a learning-theoretic perspective: we study it through the theoretical lens of the *language generation in the limit* framework, introducing a *replay* adversary that augments the example stream with the generator's own past outputs.
sentences.zh: 然而，生成模型中的模型坍缩问题尚未从学习理论视角加以审视：我们通过*极限中的语言生成*框架的理论镜头研究它，引入一个*重放*敌手，它用生成器自身过去的输出扩充示例流。

sentences.en: Our main contribution is a fine-grained learning-theoretic characterization of when replay fundamentally limits generation: while replay is benign for the strongest notion of uniform generation, it provably creates separations for the weaker notions of non-uniform generation and generation in the limit.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要贡献是对重放何时从根本上限制生成进行了细粒度学习理论刻画：虽然重放对最强者意义上的统一生成是良性的，但它可证明地在非统一生成和极限中生成的较弱意义上制造分离。

sentences.en: Interestingly, our positive results mirror heuristics widely used in practice, such as data cleaning, watermarking, and output filtering, while our separations show when these ideas can fail.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们的肯定结果映射了实践中广泛使用的启发式，如数据清洗、水印和输出过滤，而我们的分离则表明这些思想何时可能失败。

title_en: Language Model Augmented Semi-Supervised Statistical Inference
title_zh: 语言模型增强的半监督统计推断

sentences.en: Semi‑supervised statistical inference plays a key role in biomedical research, where labeled data often have higher quality but are limited due to costly clinical annotation.
sentences.zh: 半监督统计推断在生物医学研究中发挥着关键作用，其中标注数据通常质量更高，但由于临床标注成本高昂而数量有限。

sentences.en: Yet, existing semi‑supervised statistical inference methods rely heavily on structured variables and strictly matched covariates between labeled and unlabeled datasets -- limitations ill‑suited for the heterogeneity and unstructured nature of real-world biomedical data.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的半监督统计推断方法严重依赖结构化变量以及标注数据集与未标注数据集之间严格匹配的协变量——这些局限性难以适应真实世界生物医学数据的异质性和非结构化特点。

sentences.en: Modern biomedical studies increasingly collect unstructured data (clinical notes, patient audio and video recordings), with inconsistent protocols across datasets causing covariate misalignment (for instance, detailed medication histories may be recorded in one study but not another).
sentences.zh: 现代生物医学研究越来越多地收集非结构化数据（临床笔记、患者音频和视频记录），而各数据集之间不统一的协议会导致协变量错位（例如，详细的用药史可能在一个研究中被记录，而在另一个研究中却没有）。

sentences.en: Recent advances in pre‑trained multimodal large language models (LLMs), which excel at handling unstructured data, present an attractive potential solution.
sentences.zh: 近期预训练多模态大语言模型（LLMs）的发展为这一难题提供了颇具吸引力的潜在解决方案，这些模型擅长处理非结构化数据。

sentences.en: To transform this potential into rigorous semi-supervised statistical inference methods for biomedical research, two key challenges must be addressed: (1) How can we reliably integrate LLMs to enhance semi-supervised inference efficiency without compromising statistical validity?
sentences.zh: 要将这一潜力转化为适用于生物医学研究的严谨半监督统计推断方法，必须解决两个关键挑战：（1）我们如何在不损害统计有效性的前提下，可靠地整合 LLMs 以提升半监督推断效率？

sentences.en: (2) How can those efficiency gains persist despite mismatched covariates between labeled and unlabeled datasets?
sentences.zh: （2）在标注数据集与未标注数据集之间存在协变量不匹配的情况下，这些效率提升如何得以保持？

sentences.en: In this paper, we tackle these challenges by systematically *calibrating pseudo-labels* provided LLMs with a novel *prediction-invariance identification* strategy.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过一种新颖的*预测不变性识别*策略，系统地*校准* LLMs 提供的伪标签，从而应对这些挑战。

sentences.en: Our resulting semi‑supervised inference framework improves parameter estimation efficiency while maintaining full statistical validity, as demonstrated through our theoretical results and illustrated in a case study for identifying key biomarkers in Alzheimer’s disease detection with speech data.
sentences.zh: 我们由此得到的半监督推断框架在保持完全统计有效性的同时提高了参数估计效率；这一点已通过我们的理论结果得到证明，并在一个利用语音数据识别阿尔茨海默病检测中关键生物标志物的案例研究中得到展示。

title_en: Language Model Circuits Are Sparse in the Neuron Basis
title_zh: 语言模型电路在神经元基下是稀疏的

sentences.en: The high-level concepts that a neural network uses to perform computation need not be aligned to individual neurons (Smolensky, 1986).
sentences.zh: 神经网络执行计算所用的高层概念未必与单个神经元对齐（Smolensky, 1986）。

sentences.en: Language model interpretability research has thus turned to techniques such as *sparse autoencoders* (SAEs) to decompose the neuron basis into more interpretable units of model computation, for tasks such as *circuit tracing*.
sentences.zh: 因此，语言模型可解释性研究转向诸如*稀疏自编码器*（SAEs）之类的技术，将神经元基分解为更可解释的模型计算单元，用于*电路追踪*等任务。

sentences.en: However, not all neuron-based representations are uninterpretable.
sentences.zh: 然而，并非所有基于神经元的表示都是不可解释的。

sentences.en: For the first time, we empirically show that **MLP neurons are as sparse a feature basis as SAEs**.
sentences.zh: 我们首次实证表明，**MLP神经元作为特征基与SAEs一样稀疏**。

sentences.en: We use this finding to develop an end-to-end pipeline for circuit tracing on the MLP neuron basis, which locates causal circuitry on a variety of tasks using gradient-based attribution.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一发现，开发了一套在MLP神经元基上进行电路追踪的端到端流程，通过基于梯度的归因在多种任务上定位因果电路。

sentences.en: On a standard subject-verb agreement benchmark (Marks et al., 2025), a circuit of $\approx 10^2$ MLP neurons is enough to control model behaviour.
sentences.zh: 在一个标准的主动词一致基准测试（Marks等, 2025）上，约$\approx 10^2$个MLP神经元组成的电路就足以控制模型行为。

sentences.en: On the multi-hop city $\to$ state $\to$ capital task from Lindsey et al., 2025, we find a circuit in which small sets of neurons encode specific latent reasoning steps (e.g. 'map city to its state'), and can be steered to  change the model's output.
sentences.zh: 在来自Lindsey等, 2025的多跳城市$\to$州$\to$首都任务上，我们发现了一个电路，其中的小组神经元编码特定的潜在推理步骤（例如“将城市映射到其所在州”），并且可以引导该电路来改变模型的输出。

sentences.en: This work thus advances automated interpretability of language models without additional training costs.
sentences.zh: 这项工作因此在无需额外训练成本的情况下推进了语言模型的自动可解释性。

title_en: Language Model Networks: Supervision-Efficient Learning through Dense Communication
title_zh: 语言模型网络：通过密集通信实现监督高效学习

sentences.en: Language models are increasingly used not only as standalone predictors but also as components in larger inference systems, from test-time scaling to multi-agent collaboration.
sentences.zh: 语言模型日益不仅被用作独立的预测器，也被用作更大推理系统中的组件，从测试时扩展到多智能体协作皆是如此。

sentences.en: We study *language model networks*, where pre-trained language models serve as reusable nodes and intelligence emerges from their topology, communication, and optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们研究*语言模型网络*，其中预训练语言模型充当可复用的节点，而智能来源于它们之间的拓扑结构、通信与优化。

sentences.en: Existing systems mostly communicate through natural language: easy to deploy, but discrete, inefficient, and hard to optimize from end-task supervision.
sentences.zh: 现有系统大多通过自然语言进行通信：易于部署，但具有离散性、效率低下且难以从端任务监督中进行优化。

sentences.en: We propose LMNet, a dense and differentiable realization of this paradigm.
sentences.zh: 我们提出LMNet，它是这一范式的密集且可微的实现。

sentences.en: LMNet uses stripped LLMs as vertex modules and trainable seq2seq modules as communication edges, enabling intermediate nodes to exchange dense vectors while preserving natural-language input and output at the system boundary.
sentences.zh: LMNet使用精简后的LLMs作为顶点模块，可训练的seq2seq模块作为通信边，使中间节点能够交换密集向量，同时在系统边界保持自然语言的输入和输出。

sentences.en: By bypassing intermediate embedding and de-embedding, LMNet enables efficient information transfer, end-to-end gradient optimization, and learned communication beyond hand-designed protocols.
sentences.zh: 通过绕开中间的嵌入与去嵌入过程，LMNet实现了高效的信息传输、端到端的梯度优化，以及超出手工设计协议的习得式通信。

sentences.en: Experiments show performance with small additional training cost and effective adaptation under limited supervision.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在较小的额外训练成本下即可获得良好性能，并在监督有限的情况下实现有效适配。

authors.name: Shiguang Wu
authors.institution: Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University

title_en: Language-based Trial and Error Falls Behind in the Era of Experience
title_zh: 基于语言的试错在经验时代落后了

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in language-based agentic tasks, their applicability to unseen, nonlinguistic environments (e.g., symbolic or spatial tasks) remains limited.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在基于语言的智能体任务中表现出色，但它们在未见过的、非语言环境（例如符号或空间任务）中的适用性仍然有限。

sentences.en: Previous work attributes this performance gap to the mismatch between the pretraining distribution and the testing distribution.
sentences.zh: 先前工作将这一性能差距归因于预训练分布与测试分布之间的不匹配。

sentences.en: In this work, we demonstrate the primary bottleneck is the prohibitive cost of exploration: mastering these tasks requires extensive trial-and-error, which is computationally unsustainable for parameter-heavy LLMs operating in a high dimensional semantic space.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们证明主要瓶颈在于探索的代价过于高昂：掌握这些任务需要大量的试错，而这对于在高维语义空间中运行的参数庞大的LLMs来说在计算上是不可持续的。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose SCOUT (Sub-Scale Collaboration On Unseen Tasks), a novel framework that decouples exploration from exploitation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出SCOUT（Sub-Scale Collaboration On Unseen Tasks，未见过任务上的次规模协作），一个将探索与利用解耦的新颖框架。

sentences.en: We employ lightweight "scouts" (e.g., small MLPs) to probe environmental dynamics at a speed and scale far exceeding LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们使用轻量级"侦察兵"（例如小型MLPs）以远超LLMs的速度和规模探测环境动态。

sentences.en: The collected trajectories are utilized to bootstrap the LLM via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by multi-turn Reinforcement Learning (RL) to activate its latent world knowledge.
sentences.zh: 收集到的轨迹用于通过监督微调（SFT）引导LLMs，随后进行多轮强化学习（RL）以激活其潜在的世界知识。

sentences.en: Empirically, SCOUT enables a Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model to achieve an average score of 0.86, significantly outperforming proprietary models, including Gemini-2.5-Pro (0.60), while saving about 60% GPU hours consumption.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，SCOUT使Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型达到平均得分0.86，显著优于专有模型（包括Gemini-2.5-Pro的0.60），同时节省约60%的GPU小时消耗。

authors.name: Xiaogang Wang
authors.institution: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong

title_en: Laplacian Representations for Decision-Time Planning
title_zh: 决策时规划中的拉普拉斯表示

sentences.en: Planning with a learned model remains a key challenge in model-based reinforcement learning (RL).
sentences.zh: 使用学习到的模型进行规划仍是基于模型的强化学习（RL）中的关键挑战。

sentences.en: In decision-time planning, state representations are critical as they must support local cost computation while preserving long-horizon structure.
sentences.zh: 在决策时规划中，状态表示至关重要，因为它们必须支持局部代价计算，同时保持长时域结构。

sentences.en: In this paper, we show that the Laplacian representation provides an effective latent space for planning by capturing state-space distances at multiple time scales.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们表明拉普拉斯表示通过捕捉多个时间尺度上的状态空间距离，为规划提供了有效的潜在空间。

sentences.en: This representation preserves meaningful distances and naturally decomposes long-horizon problems into subgoals, also mitigating the compounding errors that arise over long prediction horizons.
sentences.zh: 这种表示保留了有意义的距离，并自然地将长时域问题分解为子目标，同时也缓解了在长预测时域中产生的累积误差。

sentences.en: Building on these properties, we introduce ALPS, a hierarchical planning algorithm, and demonstrate that it outperforms commonly used model-free baselines on a selection of offline goal-conditioned RL tasks from OGBench.
sentences.zh: 基于这些性质，我们提出了层次化规划算法ALPS，并证明它在OGBench的多个离线目标条件RL任务上优于常用的无模型基线。

title_en: LAPRAS : Learning-Augmented PRivate  Answering for linear query Streams.
title_zh: LAPRAS：线性查询流的学习增强私有回答

sentences.en: Modern database workloads are highly predictable: query streams are dominated by recurring jobs and templates, even when their arrival order is not known in advance.
sentences.zh: 现代数据库工作负载具有高度可预测性：查询流由重复出现的作业和模板主导，即使它们的到达顺序无法事先得知。

sentences.en: This motivates a learning-augmented view of online differentially private (DP) analytics: can algorithms utilize predictions about *which* queries will occur to improve utility under a single global privacy budget, while remaining robust when predictions are wrong?
sentences.zh: 这激发了在线差分隐私（DP）分析的学习增强视角：算法能否利用关于*哪些*查询会出现的预测，在单一全局隐私预算下提升效用，同时在预测出错时保持稳健？

sentences.en: We study online DP query answering, where a curator must answer a stream $Q$ of $S$ linear queries arriving in uniformly random order under privacy budget $(\epsilon,\delta)$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在线DP查询回答问题：一个策展者必须在一个流中回答$Q$个按均匀随机顺序到达的线性查询中的$S$个，且满足隐私预算$(\epsilon,\delta)$。

sentences.en: We present *LAPRAS*, which assumes access to an oracle that outputs a prediction set of queries likely to appear in the stream and uses it to guide privacy spending.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*LAPRAS*，它假设可以访问一个预言机，输出很可能出现在流中的查询预测集合，并利用该集合来引导隐私支出的分配。

sentences.en: LAPRAS answers predicted queries using the offline-optimal Matrix Mechanism and answers the remaining queries online from a residual budget.
sentences.zh: LAPRAS使用离线最优的矩阵机制来回答被预测的查询，并从剩余预算中在线回答其余查询。

sentences.en: To pace spending across an unknown number of unpredicted queries, we introduce *Smooth Allocation*, which forms an unbiased stopping-time estimate $\widehat{B}$ from the first $T=\Theta(\log^2 S)$ unpredicted queries and continuously recalibrates per-query expenditure.
sentences.zh: 为了在未知数量的未预测查询间调控支出节奏，我们引入*平滑分配*（Smooth Allocation），它从前$T=\Theta(\log^2 S)$个未预测查询中形成一个无偏的停时估计$\widehat{B}$，并持续重新校准每个查询的支出。

sentences.en: Empirically, over two real datasets, we validate the intended consistency--robustness trade-off: LAPRAS achieves near-offline utility under high overlap and degrades gracefully to baseline-level performance when overlap is low.
sentences.zh: 实验上，我们在两个真实数据集上验证了预期的一致性—稳健性权衡：在高重叠率下LAPRAS达到接近离线的效用，而在低重叠率时则优雅地退化到基线水平。

title_en: LaRA-Fusion: Latent-Robust Adaptation via Dual-Loop Constraints for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
title_zh: LaRA-Fusion：用于红外和可见光图像融合的双循环约束潜在鲁棒自适应

sentences.en: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) aims to synergize complementary thermal radiation and textural details for comprehensive scene perception.
sentences.zh: 红外与可见光图像融合（IVIF）旨在综合互补的热辐射与纹理细节，以实现全面的场景感知。

sentences.en: However, existing unsupervised paradigms often overlook the intrinsic topological consistency shared across modalities.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的无监督范式往往忽视了跨模态共享的内在拓扑一致性。

sentences.en: Lacking explicit geometric regularization, encoders frequently succumb to degenerate numerical shortcuts, capturing superficial high-frequency noise rather than domain-invariant semantic structures to satisfy reconstruction objectives.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏显式的几何正则化，编码器经常滑入退化的数值捷径，捕获表面的高频噪声而非域不变的语义结构来满足重建目标。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose LaRA-Fusion, a framework achieving Latent-Robust Adaptation via Dual-Loop Manifold Constraints.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出LaRA-Fusion，一个通过双循环流形约束实现潜在鲁棒自适应的框架。

sentences.en: We construct a strictly constrained latent space where an inner loop enforces geometric reversibility, while an outer loop aligns the generated representations with the target data distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个严格约束的潜在空间，其中内循环强制几何可逆性，而外循环则将生成的表示与目标数据分布对齐。

sentences.en: This mechanism effectively mitigates latent space collapse, compelling the model to extract topologically aligned features that remain robust against modality-specific variations.
sentences.zh: 这一机制有效缓解了潜在空间坍缩，迫使模型提取拓扑对齐的特征，这些特征对模态特有的变化保持鲁棒。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LaRA-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods with superior robustness and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LaRA-Fusion在鲁棒性和可解释性方面均优于最先进的方法。

title_en: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: LARA：视觉-语言-行动模型的潜在行动表示对齐

sentences.en: Visual-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型使机器人能够直接从观测和语言指令中预测行动，但其性能依赖于大规模、高质量的数据，并受到真实世界机器人行动数据集稀缺的限制。

sentences.en: To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning.
sentences.zh: 为了利用大量无标注的人类视频促进VLA模型学习，潜在行动模型（LAM）从视觉动态中学习潜在行动表示，为VLA学习提供额外的监督。

sentences.en: However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，LAM和VLA通常分开训练，导致LAM在VLA训练期间缺乏基础支撑，而VLA模型则受限于冻结的LAM表示。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出潜在行动表示对齐（LARA），一个通过表示对齐联合优化LAM和VLA的即插即用框架。

sentences.en: This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories.
sentences.zh: 这带来了互惠益处：LAM借助行动轨迹学习以避免虚假的视觉变化，而VLA则通过LAM中学到的前向动态进行正则化，以减少对功能无效轨迹的幻觉。

sentences.en: We demonstrate LARA's versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了LARA在预训练、预训练VLA模型的训练后增强以及LAM改进方面的多功能性和有效性，在3个模拟和1个精心设计的真实世界机器人操作基准上实现了平均约10%、5%和15%的提升。

sentences.en: The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lmy1001/LARA.
sentences.zh: 代码已在 https://github.com/lmy1001/LARA 公开提供。

title_en: LARFT: Closing the Cognition-Action Gap for Length Instruction Following  in Large Language Models
title_zh: LARFT：弥合大语言模型在长度指令遵循中的认知-行动差距

sentences.en: Despite the strong performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex instruction-following tasks, precise control of output length remains a persistent challenge.
sentences.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在复杂的指令遵循任务上表现出强劲性能，但对输出长度的精确控制仍是一个持续存在的挑战。

sentences.en: Existing methods primarily attempt to enforce length constraints by externally imposing length signals or optimization objectives, while largely overlooking the underlying limitation: the model's intrinsic deficit in length cognition.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要通过外部施加长度信号或优化目标来强制长度约束，却在很大程度上忽略了根本的局限：模型在长度认知上的内在缺陷。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **LARFT** (**L**ength-**A**ware **R**einforcement **F**ine-**T**uning), a training framework that aligns the model's length cognition with its action.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出**LARFT**（**L**ength-**A**ware **R**einforcement **F**ine-**T**uning，长度感知强化微调），一个将模型的长度认知与其行动对齐的训练框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, LARFT integrates length-oriented reinforcement learning with a hindsight length awareness.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LARFT将面向长度的强化学习与事后长度感知相整合。

sentences.en: By transforming on-policy data into hindsight self-awareness tasks where the model learns to identify the actual length of its own generation, LARFT jointly optimizes the model’s internal representation of length information and refines its policy to satisfy length constraints, thereby achieving precise and reliable length instruction following.
sentences.zh: 通过将在策略数据转化为事后自我感知任务——模型在该任务中学习识别自身生成内容的实际长度——LARFT联合优化模型对长度信息的内部表示，并细化其策略以满足长度约束，从而实现对长度指令的精确且可靠的遵循。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across four base models demonstrate that LARFT outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average improvement of **+20.92** points across three length instruction following benchmarks with only a marginal decline of **-1.45** points on four general capability benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 跨四个基础模型的大量实验表明，LARFT优于现有基线，在三个长度指令遵循基准上平均提升**+20.92**分，而仅在四个通用能力基准上出现**-1.45**分的微小下降。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Captain-zhangw/LARFT.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Captain-zhangw/LARFT 获取。

title_en: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
title_zh: 大语言模型智能体并不总是忠实的自我进化者

sentences.en: Self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents continually improve by accumulating and reusing past experience, yet it remains unclear whether they faithfully rely on that experience to guide their behavior.
sentences.zh: 自我进化的大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过积累和重用以往经验而不断改进，但尚不清楚它们是否忠实地依靠这些经验来指导自身行为。

sentences.en: We present the first systematic investigation of \emph{experience faithfulness}—the causal dependence of an agent's decisions on the experience it is given—in self-evolving LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 我们首次系统性地研究了自我进化LLM智能体中的\emph{经验忠实性}——即智能体的决策对其所获经验之间的因果依赖关系。

sentences.en: Using controlled causal interventions on both raw and condensed forms of experience, we comprehensively evaluate four representative frameworks across 13 LLM backbones and 9 environments.
sentences.zh: 通过在原始和浓缩两种形式的经验上施加受控的因果干预，我们跨13个LLM骨干网络和9个环境对四个代表性框架进行了全面评估。

sentences.en: Our analysis uncovers a striking asymmetry: while agents consistently depend on raw experience, they often disregard or misinterpret condensed experience, even when it is the only experience provided.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示了一个显著的对称性缺失：虽然智能体一贯依赖原始经验，但它们常常无视或误读浓缩经验，即使浓缩经验是所提供的唯一经验。

sentences.en: This gap persists across single- and multi-agent configurations and across backbone scales.
sentences.zh: 这一差距在单智能体和多智能体配置中以及各种规模骨干网络上均持续存在。

sentences.en: We trace its underlying causes to three factors: the semantic limitations of condensed content, internal processing biases that suppress experience, and task regimes where pretrained priors already suffice.
sentences.zh: 我们将其根本原因追溯为三个因素：浓缩内容的语义局限、抑制经验的内部处理偏差，以及预训练先验已足够充足的任务情境。

sentences.en: These findings challenge prevailing assumptions about self-evolving methods and underscore the need for more faithful and reliable approaches to experience integration.
sentences.zh: 这些发现挑战了关于自我进化方法的普遍假设，并强调了在经验整合方面需要更忠实、更可靠的方法。

title_en: Large Language Model Teaches Visual Students: Cross-Modality Transfer of Fine-Grained Conceptual Knowledge
title_zh: 大语言模型教导视觉学生：细粒度概念知识的跨模态迁移

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess broad conceptual knowledge acquired through large-scale text pretraining, yet their potential to supervise models in other modalities remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过大规模文本预训练获得了广泛的概念知识，但它们在监督其他模态模型方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose LaViD—Language-to-Visual Knowledge Distillation—a simple and effective framework for transferring high-level semantic knowledge from a language-only teacher to a vision-only student model.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出LaViD——语言到视觉知识蒸馏——一个简单而有效的框架，用于将高层语义知识从纯语言教师迁移到纯视觉学生模型。

sentences.en: Instead of relying on paired multimodal data, LaViD elicits conceptual signals from an LLM by prompting it to generate multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that probe semantic distinctions between visual classes.
sentences.zh: LaViD不依赖成对的多模态数据，而是通过提示LLM生成探测视觉类别之间语义区别的多项选择题（MCQs）来引出概念信号。

sentences.en: Each class is mapped to a soft label distribution over these MCQs, forming a rich conceptual signature that guides the student through an auxiliary distillation loss.
sentences.zh: 每个类别被映射到这些MCQs之上的软标签分布，形成一个丰富的概念签名，通过辅助蒸馏损失来引导学生。

sentences.en: Notably, despite using a language-only teacher without access to image data, LaViD consistently outperforms recent methods like MaKD that distill from vision-language models across multiple fine-grained benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，尽管使用无法访问图像数据的纯语言教师，LaViD在多个细粒度基准上始终优于诸如MaKD等从视觉-语言模型中进行蒸馏的最新方法。

sentences.en: It also achieves competitive or superior performance compared to state-of-the-art visual distillation methods such as DKD and MLKD, with further gains when combined with logit standardization.
sentences.zh: 与DKD和MLKD等最先进的视觉蒸馏方法相比，它也取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能，并且在结合logit标准化时还能进一步增益。

sentences.en: On the Waterbirds dataset, LaViD substantially improves worst-group accuracy, demonstrating enhanced robustness to spurious correlations with distillation.
sentences.zh: 在Waterbirds数据集上，LaViD大幅提升了最差组别的准确率，展示了通过蒸馏对虚假相关性更强的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lliangthomas/lavid}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/lliangthomas/lavid} 获取。

title_en: Large Language Models as Topological Thinkers: A Benchmark on Graph Persistent Homology
title_zh: 大语言模型作为拓扑思考者：图持续同调基准

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in scientific discovery, system modeling, and decision-making, prompting interest in their ability to reason over complex structured data.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于科学发现、系统建模和决策制定，这引起了人们对其在复杂结构化数据上进行推理的能力的兴趣。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks primarily focus on static or local graph reasoning, overlooking the high-order structures in real-world systems whose global properties evolve across multiple scales.
sentences.zh: 现有基准主要关注静态或局部的图推理，忽视了真实世界系统中跨多个尺度演化的整体属性的高阶结构。

sentences.en: We introduce LLM4PH, a benchmark that evaluates multi-scale structural reasoning through the lens of persistent homology (PH), a topological framework for tracking structural evolution.
sentences.zh: 我们引入LLM4PH，一个通过持续同调（PH）——一种追踪结构演化的拓扑框架——来评估多尺度结构推理的基准。

sentences.en: LLM4PH decomposes the PH pipeline into interpretable reasoning tasks spanning synthetic and real-world graphs, revealing that most models struggle with reasoning over structural transitions and persistence.
sentences.zh: LLM4PH将PH流程分解为涵盖合成图与真实世界图的可解释推理任务，揭示大多数模型在结构转换和持续性推理方面存在困难。

sentences.en: Beyond task-level evaluation, we perform cross-task ablations on prompt encoding and transfer, explore post-training effects, and construct a compositional PH pipeline to assess end-to-end performance.
sentences.zh: 除了任务级评估，我们还对提示编码与迁移进行跨任务消融实验，探索训练后效应，并构建一个组合式PH流程来评估端到端性能。

sentences.en: Our results provide the first in-depth view of how well LLMs bridge discrete graph structures with continuous topological abstraction, and offer insights into their potential for structure-aware scientific reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果首次深入展示了LLMs在多大程度上能够将离散图结构与连续拓扑抽象相衔接，并为它们在结构感知科学推理方面的潜力提供了见解。
