title_en: Large Language Models Develop Novel Social Biases Through Adaptive Exploration
title_zh: 大语言模型通过自适应探索产生新的社会偏见

sentences.en: As large language models (LLMs) are adopted into frameworks that grant them the capacity to make real decisions, it is increasingly important to ensure that they are unbiased.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）被采用到赋予其做出真实决策能力的框架中，确保它们不带偏见变得越来越重要。

sentences.en: In this paper, we argue that the predominant approach of simply removing existing biases from models is not enough.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们认为那种简单地移除模型中现有偏见的主流做法是不够的。

sentences.en: Using a paradigm from the psychology literature, we demonstrate that LLMs can spontaneously develop novel social biases about artificial demographic groups even when no inherent differences exist.
sentences.zh: 利用心理学文献中的一种范式，我们证明LLMs即使在不存在任何固有差异的情况下，也能自发地形成关于人工人口统计学群体的新社会偏见。

sentences.en: These biases result in highly stratified task allocations, which are less fair than assignments by human participants and are exacerbated by newer and larger models.
sentences.zh: 这些偏见导致高度分化分层（highly stratified）的任务分配，其公平性低于人类参与者的分配方式，并且在新颖和更大的模型中更为严重。

sentences.en: In social science, emergent biases like these have been shown to result from exploration-exploitation trade-offs, where the decision-maker explores too little, allowing early observations to strongly influence impressions about entire demographic groups.
sentences.zh: 在社会科学中，已有研究表明这类涌现性偏见源于探索-利用权衡，其中决策者探索过少，使得早期观察强烈影响对整个人口统计学群体的印象。

sentences.en: To alleviate this effect, we examine a series of interventions targeting model inputs, problem structure, and explicit steering.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解这一效应，我们考察了一系列针对模型输入、问题结构和显式引导的干预措施。

sentences.en: We find that explicitly incentivizing exploration most robustly reduces stratification, highlighting the need for better multifaceted objectives to mitigate bias.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，显式激励探索最能稳健地减少分层，这凸显了需要更好的多面向目标来减轻偏见。

sentences.en: These results reveal that LLMs are not merely passive mirrors of human social biases, but can actively create new ones from experience, raising urgent questions about how these systems will shape societies over time.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，LLMs不仅仅是人类社会偏见的被动镜像，还可以从经验中主动创造出新的偏见，从而引发关于这些系统将如何随时间塑造社会的迫切问题。

title_en: Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling
title_zh: 大语言模型通过潜在蒸馏进行探索

sentences.en: Generating diverse responses is crucial for test-time scaling of large language models (LLMs), yet standard stochastic sampling mostly yields surface-level lexical variation, limiting semantic exploration.
sentences.zh: 生成多样化的响应对于大语言模型（LLMs）的测试时扩展至关重要，然而标准随机采样大多只产生表面层面的词汇变化，限制了语义探索。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Exploratory Sampling (ESamp), a decoding approach that explicitly encourages semantic diversity during generation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出探索性采样（ESamp），一种在生成过程中显式鼓励语义多样性的解码方法。

sentences.en: ESamp is motivated by the well-known observation that neural networks tend to make lower-error predictions on inputs similar to those encountered before, and incur higher prediction error on novel ones.
sentences.zh: ESamp的动机来自一个广为人知的现象：神经网络倾向于在与先前见过的输入相似的输入上做出更低误差的预测，而在新奇的输入上产生更高的预测误差。

sentences.en: Building on this property, we train a lightweight Distiller at test time to predict deep-layer hidden representations of the LLM from its shallow-layer representations to model the LLM’s depth-wise representation transitions.
sentences.zh: 基于这一性质，我们在测试时训练一个轻量级蒸馏器（Distiller），从LLM的浅层表示预测其深层隐藏表示，以建模LLM在深度方向上的表示转换。

sentences.en: During decoding, the Distiller continuously adapts to the mappings induced by the current generation context.
sentences.zh: 在解码过程中，蒸馏器持续适应当前生成上下文所引发的映射关系。

sentences.en: ESamp uses the prediction error as a novelty signal to reweight candidate token extensions conditioned on the current prefix, thereby biasing decoding toward less-explored semantic patterns.
sentences.zh: ESamp以预测误差作为新颖性信号，在给定当前前缀的条件下重新加权候选标记扩展，从而将解码偏向于探索较少的语义模式。

sentences.en: ESamp is implemented with an asynchronous training--inference pipeline, with less than 5\% worst case overhead (1.2\% in the optimized release).
sentences.zh: ESamp通过异步训练-推理流程实现，最坏情况下开销小于5\%（优化版本中为1.2\%）。

sentences.en: Empirical results show that ESamp significantly boosts the Pass@k efficiency of reasoning models, showing superior or comparable performance to strong stochastic and heuristic baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，ESamp显著提升了推理模型的Pass@k效率，展现出优于或媲美强随机基线和启发式基线的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, ESamp achieves robust generalization across mathematics, science, and code generation benchmarks and breaks the trade-off between diversity and coherence in creative writing.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，ESamp在数学、科学和代码生成基准上实现了稳健的泛化，并在创意写作中打破了多样性与一致性之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Our code has released at: https://github.com/LinesHogan/tLLM.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已发布于：https://github.com/LinesHogan/tLLM。

title_en: Large Scale Manifold Balanced Clustering
title_zh: 大规模流形均衡聚类

sentences.en: Manifold clustering has demonstrated strong capability in capturing complex data structures and has been widely studied in cluster analysis.
sentences.zh: 流形聚类在捕捉复杂数据结构方面展现了强大的能力，并已在聚类分析中得到广泛研究。

sentences.en: However, many existing methods mainly focus on combining K-means with manifold learning, while overlooking the consistency between data structures and clustering labels, and often suffer from high computational cost when handling large scale data.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多现有方法主要关注将K-means与流形学习相结合，而忽略了数据结构与聚类标签之间的一致性，并且在处理大规模数据时往往计算成本高昂。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a manifold balanced clustering method based on anchor induced distance(LMBC), grounded in the relationship between K-means clustering and manifold learning.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出一种基于锚点诱导距离的流形均衡聚类方法（LMBC），其理论基础是K-means聚类与流形学习之间的关系。

sentences.en: Specifically, the LMBC uses label information to guide the construction of the manifold structure, thereby ensuring consistency between data structures and clustering labels.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LMBC利用标签信息来引导流形结构的构建，从而确保数据结构与聚类标签之间的一致性。

sentences.en: To enable large scale clustering, we introduce an anchor induced distance representation that models manifold structure in a compact anchor space, significantly reducing computational complexity while preserving essential structural information.
sentences.zh: 为了实现大规模聚类，我们引入了一种锚点诱导距离表示，在紧凑的锚点空间中建模流形结构，显著降低计算复杂度，同时保留必要的结构信息。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to naturally maintain class balance during clustering, we maximize the Schatten-p norm of the label representation and provide theoretical analysis to support its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了在聚类过程中自然地保持类别均衡，我们最大化标签表示的Schatten-p范数，并提供理论分析来支撑其有效性。

sentences.en: Experimental results on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明了所提方法的有效性和可扩展性。

title_en: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
title_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型在注意力中迷失

sentences.en: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture.
sentences.zh: 尽管训练范式迅速演进，但大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）的解码器骨干仍从根本上扎根于残差连接Transformer架构。

sentences.en: Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization.
sentences.zh: 因此，解读各内部模块的独特角色对于理解模型机制和指导架构优化至关重要。

sentences.en: While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的统计方法提供了有价值的基于归因的见解，但它们往往缺乏统一的理论基础。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework grounded in *information theory and geometry* to quantify the **geometric and entropic nature** of residual updates.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出一个以*信息论与几何*为基础的统一框架，用于量化残差更新的**几何与熵特性**。

sentences.en: Applying this unified framework reveals a fundamental functional decoupling: **Attention acts as a subspace-preserving operator** focused on reconfiguration, whereas **FFNs serve as subspace-expanding operators** driving semantic innovation.
sentences.zh: 应用这一统一框架揭示了一种根本的功能解耦：**注意力作为保持子空间算符**，专注于重构；而**FFN作为扩展子空间算符**，驱动语义创新。

sentences.en: Strikingly, further experiments demonstrate that replacing learned attention weights with predefined values (e.g., Gaussian noise) yields comparable or even superior performance across a majority of datasets relative to vanilla models.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，进一步的实验表明，使用预定义值（例如高斯噪声）替换学习到的注意力权重，在大多数数据集上都能取得与标准模型相当甚至更优的性能。

sentences.en: These results expose severe **misallocation and redundancy** in current mechanisms, suggesting that state-of-the-art LVLMs effectively ``get lost in attention'' rather than efficiently leveraging visual context.
sentences.zh: 这些结果暴露了现有机制中严重的**错配与冗余**，表明最先进的LVLMs实际上是“在注意力中迷失”，而非高效利用视觉上下文。

title_en: Large-capacity and Receiver Authenticable Generative Image Steganography
title_zh: 大容量且接收方可验证的生成式图像隐写

sentences.en: Diffusion-based generative image steganography converts the input single secret image into noise, and generates the stego image with it serves as the initial noise.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的生成式图像隐写将输入的单个秘密图像转换为噪声，并以该噪声作为初始噪声生成隐写图像。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, existing methods exhibit three severe limitations: (1) the fixed hiding space constrains their capacity to one secret image; (2) severe inter-secret interference arising from substantial information divergence among multiple secret images while concealing them within a shared hiding space; (3) security risks owing to the absence of the receiver-side verification mechanism.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法存在三个严重局限：（1）固定的隐藏空间将其容量限制为一幅秘密图像；（2）将多幅秘密图像隐藏在同一共享隐藏空间中时，由于各图像间信息差异巨大而产生的严重秘密间干扰；（3）由于缺乏接收方验证机制而带来的安全风险。

sentences.en: To systematically address these issues, this paper proposes a novel **Receiver Authenticable Generative Image Steganography framework** based on diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 为系统地解决这些问题，本文提出一个基于扩散模型的新颖**接收方可验证的生成式图像隐写框架**。

sentences.en: We introduce a **Dynamic Cover Selection and Optimization Engine** to adaptively allocate suitable hiding spaces for different secret images.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个**动态封面选择与优化引擎**，为不同的秘密图像自适应地分配合适的隐藏空间。

sentences.en: This design permits the concealment of disparate secret images (or fragments of a single image) into separate spaces, enabling dynamic multi-image concealment while effectively preventing inter-secret interference and expanding capacity through the enlarged hiding spaces.
sentences.zh: 这一设计允许将不同的秘密图像（或单幅图像的分片）隐藏到各自独立的空间中，从而实现动态的多图像隐藏，同时有效防止秘密间干扰，并通过扩大的隐藏空间增加容量。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a **Signature Authentication Controller** cryptographically signs the secret container after concealing and verifies it before extraction, ensuring secure receiver isolation and precise localization of the secret data container.
sentences.zh: 此外，一个**签名认证控制器**在隐藏完成后对秘密容器进行密码学签名，并在提取前对其验证，确保安全的接收方隔离以及秘密数据容器的精确定位。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior secure multi-receiver isolation and high-performance generative image steganography with large capacity.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，所提出的框架实现了优越的安全多接收方隔离，以及具有大容量的高性能生成式图像隐写。

title_en: Large-Scale Molecular Dynamics Simulations: Direct Interatomic Modeling with Dilated Message Passing
title_zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟：基于膨胀消息传递的直接原子间建模

sentences.en: Large-scale molecular dynamics simulations are essential in understanding chemical and biological processes, necessitating the accurate and efficient modeling of interatomic interactions.
sentences.zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟对于理解化学和生物过程至关重要，因而需要对原子间相互作用进行准确而高效的建模。

sentences.en: Existing learning-based methods are generally based on message passing mechanisms; they are either not scalable or too coarse to offer accurate modeling.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于学习的方法普遍基于消息传递机制；它们要么不可扩展，要么过于粗糙而无法提供准确的建模。

sentences.en: We propose a new message passing framework that can effectively and efficiently model interatomic interactions for simulating large-scale molecular dynamics at full atomic resolution.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新的消息传递框架，能够以全原子分辨率有效且高效地对原子间相互作用进行建模，用于模拟大规模分子动力学。

sentences.en: Specifically, our framework is stacked with a sequence of message passing neural network layers, each realizing the message passing over a distinct and dilated star-structured path.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的框架由一系列消息传递神经网络层堆叠而成，每一层都通过一条独特且膨胀的星形结构路径实现消息传递。

sentences.en: These star-structured paths are constructed progressively along dilated regions to capture the distance-dependent interactions.
sentences.zh: 这些星形结构路径沿着膨胀的区域逐步构建，以捕捉距离依赖的相互作用。

sentences.en: The crux of our framework is that it resolves the problem of dense interatomic interactions of large-scale atomic systems with sparser and region-based message passing graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们框架的关键在于，它利用更稀疏、基于区域的消息传递图来解决大规模原子系统密集的原子间相互作用问题。

sentences.en: We evaluate the framework on four benchmarks: MD22 (molecules with 42–370 atoms), Chignolin (a 166-atom protein featuring diverse conformations), the AdK dataset (a protein trajectory with up to 3,000 atoms), and the MISATO dataset (over 10,000 heterogeneous protein-ligand complexes with systems up to 40,000 atoms).
sentences.zh: 我们在四个基准上评估该框架：MD22（由42–370个原子组成的分子）、Chignolin（一个具有多种构象的166原子蛋白质）、AdK数据集（一个原子数多达3000的蛋白质轨迹）以及MISATO数据集（超过10000个异质蛋白质-配体复合物，体系原子数多达40000）。

sentences.en: Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach delivers state-of-the-art performance overall across various benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 全面的评估表明，我们的方法在多个基准上总体达到了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: The code is provided on [Github](https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026-DKMP).
sentences.zh: 代码见 [Github](https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026-DKMP)。

authors.name: Wanyu LIN
authors.institution: Department of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University

title_en: Large-Scale Notification Dispatch with Bundle Treatments and Multi-Outcome Uplift Optimization
title_zh: 具有捆绑处理与多结果Uplift优化的大规模通知分发

sentences.en: Notification dispatch plays a critical role in large-scale user engagement, involving complex trade-offs across notification timing, presentation style, multiple outcomes, and constraints.
sentences.zh: 通知分发在大型用户参与中扮演着关键角色，涉及通知时机、展示风格、多种结果以及约束等之间的复杂权衡。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formulate it as a constrained optimization over bundle treatments that jointly specify timing and presentation style, aiming to maximize incremental Daily Active Users (DAU) subject to platform-level budget and device vendor-specific quota constraints.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将其表述为一个关于捆绑处理的带约束优化问题，该捆绑处理同时指定时机和展示风格，旨在在平台级预算和设备厂商特定配额约束下最大化增量日活跃用户数（DAU）。

sentences.en: The problem is challenging due to multi-dimensional, small-effect uplift estimation and large-scale constrained optimization.
sentences.zh: 由于多维、小效应uplift估值以及大规模带约束优化，该问题颇具挑战性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{B}$undle $\textbf{U}$plift $\textbf{O}$ptimization with $\textbf{P}$runed $\textbf{L}$agrangian-based $\textbf{R}$elaxation (BUOPLR), a two-stage notification dispatch method that decouples uplift estimation from constrained decision-making.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出\textbf{Bundle Uplift Optimization with Pruned Lagrangian-based Relaxation\}（捆绑Uplift优化与剪枝拉格朗日松弛，BUOPLR），一种将uplift估计与带约束决策制定解耦的两阶段通知分发方法。

sentences.en: BUOPLR first learns bundle-level, multi-outcome small uplift through an architecture that captures cross-treatment and cross-outcome relationships, and then performs scalable assignment by restricting the decision space and applying Lagrangian relaxation to a small set of global constraints.
sentences.zh: BUOPLR首先通过一个能捕捉跨处理与跨结果关系的架构来学习捆绑级、多结果的小效应uplift，然后通过收窄决策空间并对一小部分全局约束应用拉格朗日松弛来进行可扩展的分配。

sentences.en: Offline experiments show BUOPLR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and online A/B tests increase DAU by 0.5\%.
sentences.zh: 离线实验表明，BUOPLR优于最先进的方法，在线A/B测试将DAU提升了0.5\%。

sentences.en: BUOPLR is now deployed on Kuaishou, a large-scale short video platform serving over 100 million users daily.
sentences.zh: BUOPLR现已部署在快手（Kuaishou）上，这是一个每日服务超过1亿用户的大型短视频平台。

title_en: Large-Scale Terminal Agentic Trajectory Generation from Dockerized Environments
title_zh: 从Docker化环境进行大规模终端智能体轨迹生成

sentences.en: Training agentic models for terminal-based tasks critically depends on high-quality terminal trajectories that capture realistic long-horizon interactions across diverse domains.
sentences.zh: 为基于终端的任务训练智能体模型，关键依赖于能够捕捉跨不同领域真实长时域交互的高质量终端轨迹。

sentences.en: However, constructing such data at scale remains challenging due to two key requirements: \textbf{\emph{Executability}}, since each instance requires a suitable and often distinct Docker environment; and \textbf{\emph{Verifiability}}, because heterogeneous task outputs preclude unified, standardized verification.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于两个关键要求，规模化构建此类数据仍颇具挑战：\textbf{\emph{可执行性}}（Executability）：每个实例都需要一个合适且往往不同的Docker环境；以及\textbf{\emph{可验证性}}（Verifiability）：因为异构的任务输出无法采用统一、标准化的验证方式。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{TerminalTraj}, a scalable pipeline that (i) filters high-quality repositories to construct Dockerized execution environments, (ii) generates Docker-aligned task instances, and (iii) synthesizes agent trajectories with executable validation code.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出\textbf{TerminalTraj}\，一个可扩展的流水线，它（1）筛选高质量仓库以构建Docker化执行环境，（2）生成与Docker对齐的任务实例，（3）用可执行的验证代码合成智能体轨迹。

sentences.en: Using TerminalTraj, we curate 32K Docker images and generate 50,733 verified terminal trajectories across eight domains.
sentences.zh: 借助TerminalTraj，我们整理了32K个Docker镜像，并在八个领域生成了50,733条经过验证的终端轨迹。

sentences.en: Models trained on this data with the Qwen2.5-Coder backbone achieve consistent performance improvements on TerminalBench (TB), with gains of up to 20\% on TB 1.0 and 10\% on TB 2.0 over their respective backbones.
sentences.zh: 以Qwen2.5-Coder为骨干、在此数据上训练的模型在TerminalBench（TB）上取得了持续的性能提升，相较于各自的骨干，在TB 1.0上最高提升20\%，在TB 2.0上最高提升10\%。

sentences.en: Notably, \textbf{TerminalTraj-32B} achieves strong performance among models with fewer than 100B parameters, reaching 35.30\% on TB 1.0 and 22.00\% on TB 2.0, and demonstrates improved test-time scaling behavior.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，\textbf{TerminalTraj-32B}\在参数少于100B的模型中取得了强劲性能，在TB 1.0上达到35.30\%，在TB 2.0上达到22.00\%，并展现出改进的测试时扩展行为。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Large-scale Uncertainty Quantification for Latent Variable Models Using Subsampling Markov Chain Monte Carlo
title_zh: 使用子采样马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛对潜变量模型进行大规模不确定性量化

sentences.en: Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics combined with Gibbs updates (SGLD-Gibbs) provides a highly scalable approach to approximate Bayesian inference in latent variable models.
sentences.zh: 随机梯度朗之万动力学与Gibbs更新相结合（SGLD-Gibbs）为潜变量模型中的近似贝叶斯推断提供了一种高度可扩展的方法。

sentences.en: However, it remains unclear how to tune the algorithm's hyperparameters in a principled manner to ensure the uncertainty estimates are statistically meaningful.
sentences.zh: 然而，如何以有原则的方式调整该算法的超参数以确保不确定性估计在统计上有意义，仍不明确。

sentences.en: In this work, we address this gap in tuning guidance by developing a statistical scaling limit theory for SGLD-Gibbs.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过为SGLD-Gibbs发展一套统计缩放极限理论来弥补这一调参指导方面的空白。

sentences.en: We derive a joint asymptotic limit for the global parameters and latent variables under appropriate space-time rescaling.
sentences.zh: 在适当的时空重缩放下，我们推导出全局参数与潜变量的联合渐近极限。

sentences.en: We show that global parameters converge to a diffusion-type limit, while individual latent variables converge to a jump process reflecting their intermittent Gibbs updates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，全局参数收敛到一个扩散型极限，而各个潜变量则收敛到一个反映其间歇性Gibbs更新的跳跃过程。

sentences.en: This joint jump-diffusion structure reveals how latent-variable randomness contributes to the stationary distribution of the global parameters.
sentences.zh: 这种联合的跳跃-扩散结构揭示了潜变量随机性如何对全局参数的平稳分布做出贡献。

sentences.en: We leverage our results to provide explicit guidance on hyperparameter tuning for SGLD-Gibbs that ensures meaningful uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这些结果，为SGLD-Gibbs提供了确保有意义的不确定性量化的显式超参数调参指导。

sentences.en: Our empirical results show that SGLD-Gibbs with our tuning guidance leads to better parameter estimates and uncertainty quantification than stochastic variational inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证结果表明，采用我们调参指导的SGLD-Gibbs在参数估计和不确定性量化方面都优于随机变分推断。

title_en: LaRI: Layered Ray Intersections for Single-view 3D Geometric Reasoning
title_zh: LaRI：用于单视图3D几何推理的分层射线相交

sentences.en: We present Layered Ray Intersections (LaRI), a fully supervised method for occluded geometry reasoning from a single image.
sentences.zh: 我们提出分层射线相交（LaRI），一种用于从单张图像进行遮挡几何推理的全监督方法。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional depth estimation, which is limited to visible surfaces, LaRI predicts multiple surfaces intersected by the camera rays using layered point maps.
sentences.zh: 与仅限于可见表面的传统深度估计不同，LaRI使用分层点图预测相机射线所穿过的多个表面。

sentences.en: Compared to the existing approaches that leverage neural implicit representations or iterative refinement, LaRI achieves complete scene reconstruction in one feed-forward pass, enabling efficient and view-aligned geometric reasoning to underpin both object-level and scene-level tasks.
sentences.zh: 与利用神经隐式表示或迭代细化的现有方法相比，LaRI在一次前馈传播中即可实现完整的场景重建，从而能够进行高效且视图对齐的几何推理，为物体级和场景级任务提供支撑。

sentences.en: We further propose to predict the ray stopping index, which identifies valid intersecting pixels and layers from LaRI's output.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出预测射线停止索引，用以识别LaRI输出中有效的相交像素和层。

sentences.en: To better underpin and evaluate this task, we build an annotation pipeline using rendering engines, construct annotations for five public datasets, including synthetic and real-world data covering 3D objects and scenes.
sentences.zh: 为更好地支撑和评估这一任务，我们利用渲染引擎构建了一条标注流水线，并为五个公共数据集（包括涵盖3D物体与场景的合成及真实世界数据）构建了标注。

sentences.en: As a generic method, LaRI's performance is validated in object-level and scene-level reconstruction tasks.
sentences.zh: 作为一种通用方法，LaRI的性能在物体级和场景级重建任务中得到了验证。

authors.name: Zhenyu Li
authors.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

title_en: LASER: Learning Active Sensing for Continuum Field Reconstruction
title_zh: LASER：用于连续场重建的学习主动感知

sentences.en: High-fidelity measurements of continuum physical fields are essential for scientific discovery and engineering design but remain challenging under sparse and constrained sensing.
sentences.zh: 连续物理场的高保真测量对于科学发现与工程设计至关重要，但在稀疏和受限的感知条件下仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Conventional reconstruction methods typically rely on fixed sensor layouts, which cannot adapt to evolving physical states.
sentences.zh: 传统的重建方法通常依赖固定的传感器布局，无法适应不断演化的物理状态。

sentences.en: We propose LASER, a unified, closed-loop framework that formulates active sensing as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP).
sentences.zh: 我们提出LASER，一个统一的闭环框架，将主动感知表述为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。

sentences.en: At its core, LASER employs a continuum field latent world model that captures the underlying physical dynamics and provides intrinsic reward feedback.
sentences.zh: 其核心是，LASER采用一个连续场潜在世界模型，捕捉底层物理动态并提供内在奖励反馈。

sentences.en: This enables a reinforcement learning policy to simulate ''what-if'' sensing scenarios within a latent imagination space.
sentences.zh: 这使得强化学习策略能够在潜在想象空间中模拟\"what-if\"（如果怎么写）的感知场景。

sentences.en: By conditioning sensor movements on predicted latent states, LASER navigates toward potentially high-information regions beyond current observations.
sentences.zh: 通过根据预测的潜在状态来调节传感器移动，LASER能够朝着当前观测之外潜在的高信息区域前进。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that LASER consistently outperforms static and offline-optimized strategies, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction under sparsity across diverse continuum fields.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，LASER始终优于静态和离线优化策略，在多种连续场的稀疏条件下实现了高保真重建。

authors.name: Xiaokang Yang
authors.institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University of China

title_en: LassoFlexNet: a Flexible Neural Architecture for Tabular Data
title_zh: LassoFlexNet：一种灵活的表格数据神经架构

sentences.en: Despite their dominance in vision and language, deep neural networks often underperform relative to tree-based models on tabular data.
sentences.zh: 尽管深度神经网络在视觉和语言领域占据主导地位，但在表格数据上它们往往逊色于基于树的模型。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we incorporate five key inductive biases into deep tabular learning: robustness to irrelevant features, axis alignment,  localized irregularities, feature heterogeneity, and training stability.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们将五种关键归纳偏置融入深度表格学习：对无关特征的鲁棒性、坐标对齐（轴对齐）、局部不规则性、特征异质性以及训练稳定性。

sentences.en: We propose *LassoFlexNet*,  an architecture that evaluates the linear and nonlinear marginal contribution of each input via Per-Feature Embeddings,  and sparsely selects relevant variables using a Tied Group Lasso mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*LassoFlexNet*，一种通过逐特征嵌入（Per-Feature Embeddings）评估每个输入的线性和非线性边际贡献、并使用捆绑组Lasso（Tied Group Lasso）机制稀疏选择相关变量的架构。

sentences.en: Because these components introduce optimization challenges that destabilize standard proximal methods,  we analyze stochastic hierarchical proximal dynamics and develop a *Sequential Hierarchical Proximal Adaptive Gradient optimizer with exponential moving averages (EMA)* designed to stabilize training in practice.
sentences.zh: 由于这些组件引入了会使标准近端方法不稳定的优化挑战，我们分析随机层次近端动态，并开发了一个*具有指数移动平均的序列化层次近端自适应梯度优化器（EMA）*，旨在实际中稳定训练。

sentences.en: Across 52 datasets from three benchmarks, LassoFlexNet matches or outperforms leading tree-based models,  achieving up to a $10$\% relative gain, while maintaining Lasso-like interpretability.
sentences.zh: 在来自三个基准的52个数据集上，LassoFlexNet匹配或超越了领先的基于树的模型，最高实现$10$\%的相对提升，同时保持了类Lasso的可解释性。

sentences.en: We substantiate these empirical results with ablation studies and theoretical proofs  confirming the architecture's enhanced expressivity and structural breaking of undesired rotational invariance.
sentences.zh: 我们通过消融研究和理论证明来佐证这些实验结果，确认了该架构增强的表达能力以及对不良旋转不变性的结构性破除。

title_en: LaST$_{0}$: Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought for Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model
title_zh: LaST$_{0}$：机器人视觉-语言-行动模型的潜在时空思维链

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong generalization, with some approaches seeking to explicitly generate linguistic reasoning traces or predict future observations prior to execution.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型近期展现出强大的泛化能力，一些方法试图在执行前显式生成语言推理痕迹或预测未来观测。

sentences.en: However, explicit reasoning typically incurs non-negligible inference latency, which constrains the temporal resolution required for robotic manipulation.
sentences.zh: 然而，显式推理通常会带来不可忽视的推理延迟，这限制了机器人操作所需的时空分辨率。

sentences.en: Moreover, such reasoning is confined to the linguistic space, imposing a representational bottleneck that struggles to faithfully capture ineffable physical attributes.
sentences.zh: 此外，此类推理局限于语言空间，造成表示瓶颈，难以忠实地捕捉难以言传的物理属性。

sentences.en: To mitigate these limitations, we propose LaST$_0$, a framework that enables efficient reasoning before acting through a Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought (CoT), capturing fine-grained physical and robotic dynamics that are often difficult to verbalize.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这些局限，我们提出LaST$_0$，一个通过潜在时空思维链（CoT）在行动前实现高效推理的框架，捕捉往往难以用语言表达的细粒度物理与机器人动态。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce a token-efficient latent CoT space that models future visual dynamics, 3D structural information, and robot proprioceptive states, and further extends these representations across time to enable temporally consistent implicit reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入一个令牌高效（token-efficient）的潜在CoT空间，对未来的视觉动态、3D结构信息和机器人本体感受状态进行建模，并将这些表示随时间进一步扩展，以实现时间一致性的隐式推理轨迹。

sentences.en: Furthermore, LaST$_0$ adopts a dual-system architecture implemented via a Mixture-of-Transformers design, where a reasoning expert conducts low-frequency latent inference and an acting expert generates high-frequency actions conditioned on robotics-oriented latent representations.
sentences.zh: 此外，LaST$_0$采用通过混合Transformer（Mixture-of-Transformers）设计实现的双系统架构，其中推理专家执行低频潜在推理，行动专家基于面向机器人的潜在表示生成高频行动。

sentences.en: To facilitate coordination, LaST$_0$ is trained with heterogeneous operation frequencies, enabling adaptive switching during deployment.
sentences.zh: 为促进协调，LaST$_0$以异构操作频率进行训练，使得在部署期间能够自适应切换。

sentences.en: Across 10 real-world tasks spanning tabletop, mobile, and dexterous hand manipulation, LaST$_0$ improves mean success rates by 13%, 14% and 14% over prior SOTA VLA methods, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖桌面、移动和灵巧手操作的10个真实世界任务中，与先前的SOTA VLA方法相比，LaST$_0$分别将平均成功率提升了13%、14%和14%。

title_en: Last-iterate Convergence of ADMM on Multi-affine Quadratic Equality Constrained Problem
title_zh: ADMM在多仿射二次等式约束问题上的末次迭代收敛性

sentences.en: In this paper, we study a class of non-convex optimization problems known as multi-affine quadratic equality constrained problems, which appear in various applications--from generating feasible force trajectories in robotic locomotion and manipulation to training neural networks.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究一类称为多仿射二次等式约束问题的非凸优化问题，它们出现在各种应用中——从机器人运动和操作中生成可行力轨迹，到训练神经网络。

sentences.en: Although these problems are generally non-convex, they exhibit convexity or related properties when all variables except one are fixed.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些问题通常是非凸的，但当除一个变量外的所有变量都被固定时，它们会表现出凸性或相关性质。

sentences.en: Under mild assumptions, we prove that the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) converges when applied to this class of problems.
sentences.zh: 在温和假设下，我们证明交替方向乘子法（ADMM）应用于这类问题时会收敛。

sentences.en: Furthermore, when the "degree" of non-convexity in the constraints remains within certain bounds, we show that ADMM achieves a linear convergence rate.
sentences.zh: 此外，当约束中非凸性的\"程度\"保持在特定界限内时，我们证明ADMM能够实现线性收敛速率。

sentences.en: We validate our theoretical results through practical examples in robotic locomotion.
sentences.zh: 我们通过机器人运动中的实际例子验证了我们的理论结果。

title_en: Last-Iterate Convergence of Regularized Gradient Methods for Stochastic Monotone Variational Inequalities
title_zh: 随机单调变分不等式正则化梯度方法的末次迭代收敛性

sentences.en: We study last-iterate convergence for stochastic smooth and monotone variational inequalities (VIs), a framework that captures convex-concave saddle points and Nash equilibrium computation in monotone games with noisy payoff feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们研究随机光滑单调变分不等式（VIs）的末次迭代收敛性，该框架能够刻画单调博弈中带有噪声收益反馈的凸-凹鞍点和Nash均衡计算。

sentences.en: In contrast to the well-understood average-iterate guarantees, anytime last-iterate guarantees in stochastic settings remain limited, despite their relevance for uncoupled learning dynamics that output a single current strategy.
sentences.zh: 与已被充分理解的均值迭代保证相比，随机设置下的随时随地（anytime）末次迭代保证仍然有限，尽管这些保证对于输出单一当前策略的非耦合学习动态而言十分重要。

sentences.en: We analyze two single-call regularized methods, the \emph{regularized gradient (RG)} and the \emph{regularized optimistic gradient (ROG)} methods, and establish anytime last-iterate convergence rates in terms of the squared gap function.
sentences.zh: 我们分析两种单次调用（single-call）的正则化方法，即\emph{正则化梯度（regularized gradient，RG)}和\emph{正则化乐观梯度（regularized optimistic gradient，ROG)}方法，并建立了以平方间隙函数表示的随时随地末次迭代收敛速率。

sentences.en: For monotone VIs, RG attains $O(t^{-2/5})$ while ROG achieves the variance-adaptive rate $O(\sigma^{4/5} t^{-2/5} + t^{-1})$, where $\sigma^2$ is the noise variance.
sentences.zh: 对于单调VIs，RG达到O($t^{-2/5}$)，而ROG实现了方差自适应速率O($\sigma^{4/5} t^{-2/5} + t^{-1}$)，其中$\sigma^2$是噪声方差。

sentences.en: For $\lambda$-strongly monotone VIs, ROG yields $O(\sigma^2 / (\lambda^2 t) + t^{-c})$ for any constant $c \ge 2$.
sentences.zh: 对于$\lambda$-强单调VIs，对于任意常数$c\ge 2$，ROG给出O($\sigma^2 / (\lambda^2 t) + t^{-c}$)。

sentences.en: These results give anytime last-iterate guarantees without knowing the horizon and show that optimism improves convergence in the low-noise regime.
sentences.zh: 这些结果在不事先知道时域（horizon）的情况下给出了随时随地末次迭代保证，并表明乐观性在低噪声情境下改善收敛。

title_en: LAST: Bridging Vision-Language and Action Manifolds via Gromov-Wasserstein Alignment
title_zh: LAST：通过Gromov-Wasserstein对齐桥接视觉-语言与行动流形

sentences.en: We formulate the learning of generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models as a Gromov-Wasserstein alignment problem, aiming to map semantically similar VL embeddings to physically similar motion primitives.
sentences.zh: 我们将通用视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型的学习表述为一个Gromov-Wasserstein对齐问题，旨在将语义相似的VL嵌入映射到物理相似的运动原语上。

sentences.en: However, solving this is challenging due to the mathematical heterogeneity between the domains: the semantic space of vision-language is topologically linear and isotropic, while the physical manifold of robotic action is non-Euclidean and anisotropic.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于各领域之间的数学异质性，求解这一问题颇具挑战：视觉-语言的语义空间在拓扑上是线性的且各向同性，而机器人行动的物理流形则是非欧几里得的且各向异性的。

sentences.en: As a result, direct regression approaches fail due to the disjoint metric structures of these domains, making standard distance minimization ill-posed.
sentences.zh: 因此，直接的回归方法会因这些领域不连续的度量结构而失败，使得标准的距离最小化成为不适定（ill-posed）问题。

sentences.en: To resolve this incompatibility, we introduce LAST (Lie-algebraic Action Space Tokenizer).
sentences.zh: 为解决这种不兼容性，我们引入LAST（李代数行动空间分词器，Lie-algebraic Action Space Tokenizer）。

sentences.en: LAST reconstructs the action space to establish a more consistent metric alignment between the VL and Action modalities.
sentences.zh: LAST重构行动空间，以在VL与行动模态之间建立更一致的度量对齐。

sentences.en: Specifically, LAST bridges the heterogeneity via two stages: (1) *Global Topological Linearization*, which linearizes the action manifold through Lie-algebraic mapping, converting trajectories into a fixed-length, physically additive representation; and (2) *Local Metric Discretization*, where the representation is discretized hierarchically into schemas and whitened residuals, establishing a mathematical isomorphism with the isotropic Euclidean metric.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，LAST通过两个阶段桥接异质性：（1）*全局拓扑线性化*，通过李代数映射将行动流形线性化，把轨迹转换为固定长度、物理可加性的表示；（2）*局部度量离散化*，将表示层次化地离散为模式和自化（whitened）残差，与各向同性欧几里得度量建立数学同构。

sentences.en: By addressing the structural mismatch globally and locally, LAST enables VLA models with enhanced convergence and generalizability.
sentences.zh: 通过在全局和局部层面处理结构不匹配，LAST使VLA模型获得更强的收敛性和泛化能力。

title_en: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 多智能体系统中的潜在协作

sentences.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) extend large language models (LLMs) from independent single-model reasoning to coordinative system-level intelligence.
sentences.zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）将大语言模型（LLMs）从独立的单模型推理扩展到协调的系统级智能。

sentences.en: While existing LLM agents depend on text-based mediation for reasoning and communication, we take a step forward by enabling models to collaborate directly within the continuous latent space.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的LLM智能体依赖基于文本的中介来进行推理和通信，但我们更进一步，使模型能够在连续潜在空间内直接协作。

sentences.en: We introduce LatentMAS, an end-to-end training-free framework that enables pure latent collaboration among LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 我们提出LatentMAS，一个端到端免训练的框架，能够在LLM智能体之间实现纯潜在协作。

sentences.en: In LatentMAS, each agent first performs auto-regressive latent thoughts generation through last-layer hidden embeddings instead of text.
sentences.zh: 在LatentMAS中，每个智能体首先通过最后一层的隐藏嵌入（而非文本）进行自回归潜在思维生成。

sentences.en: Then, a shared latent working memory preserves and transfers each agent's internal representations and latent thoughts, ensuring lossless information exchange without re-encoding.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个共享的潜在工作记忆保存并传递每个智能体的内部表示和潜在思维，确保无需重新编码即可实现无损信息交换。

sentences.en: We provide detailed theoretical analyses showing that LatentMAS achieves higher expressiveness and lossless information preservation with lower overall complexity than standard text-based MAS.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了详细的理论分析，表明与标准基于文本的MAS相比，LatentMAS以更低的整体复杂度实现了更高的表达能力和无损信息保留。

sentences.en: In addition, empirical evaluations across 9 comprehensive benchmarks spanning math and science reasoning, commonsense understanding, and code generation show that LatentMAS outperforms advanced single agents and text-based MAS baselines, achieving up to 14.6\% higher accuracy, reducing output token usage by 70.8\%-83.7\%, and providing 4$\times$-4.3$\times$ faster end-to-end inference.
sentences.zh: 此外，在涵盖数学与科学推理、常识理解和代码生成的9个综合基准上的实证评估表明，LatentMAS优于先进的单智能体和基于文本的MAS基线，准确率最高提升14.6\%，输出令牌使用量减少70.8\%-83.7\%，并提供4$\times$-4.3$\times$更快的端到端推理。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that our new latent collaboration framework enhances system-level reasoning quality while providing consistent efficiency gains.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，我们新的潜在协作框架在提升系统级推理质量的同时提供了持续的效率增益。

title_en: Latent Diffusion Pretraining for Crystal Property Prediction
title_zh: 用于晶体性质预测的潜在扩散预训练

sentences.en: Fast and accurate prediction of crystal properties is a central challenge in new materials design.
sentences.zh: 快速而准确地预测晶体性质是新材料设计中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Graph neural networks and Transformer-based models have emerged as powerful tools for this task due to their ability to encode the local structural environment of atoms within a crystal.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络和基于Transformer的模型因能够编码晶体内原子的局部结构环境，已成为这一任务的有力工具。

sentences.en: However, these models are data-hungry and in practice labeled data for crystal properties are very scarce.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些模型对数据的需求量大，而实践中晶体性质的标注数据非常稀缺。

sentences.en: Pretraining–finetuning strategies, particularly those based on diffusion models, have shown promise in addressing these limitations.
sentences.zh: 预训练-微调策略，尤其是基于扩散模型的策略，在应对这些局限方面已显示出前景。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a novel latent-diffusion based pretraining framework CrysLDNet, designed to mitigate the data scarcity.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一个新颖的基于潜在扩散的预训练框架CrysLDNet，旨在缓解数据稀缺问题。

sentences.en: Our approach integrates a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with a diffusion model during the pretraining stage.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在预训练阶段将变分自编码器（VAE）与扩散模型相结合。

sentences.en: The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a smooth latent space, within which the diffusion process is applied.
sentences.zh: VAE编码器将3D晶体结构映射到平滑的潜在空间，扩散过程就在该空间内进行。

sentences.en: This latent diffusion pretraining enables the graph encoder to effectively capture structural and chemical semantics from large-scale unlabeled data, which can then be finetuned for specific property prediction tasks.
sentences.zh: 这种潜在扩散预训练使图编码器能够从大规模无标注数据中有效捕捉结构与化学语义，随后可针对特定的性质预测任务进行微调。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on popular DFT datasets for property prediction reveal that CrysLDNet significantly outperforms both training-from-scratch and pretrained baselines, with improvements of ***4.26%*** and ***4.90%*** on the JARVIS and MP datasets.
sentences.zh: 在常用DFT数据集上进行性质预测的综合实验表明，CrysLDNet显著优于从零训练和预训练的基线，在JARVIS和MP数据集上分别提升了***4.26%***和***4.90%***。

sentences.en: Additionally, the learned representations remain robust in sparse-data conditions and are expressive enough to correct DFT errors when finetuned with limited experimental data.
sentences.zh: 此外，学习到的表示在稀疏数据条件下依然稳健，并且表达能力足够强，可在使用有限的实验数据微调时纠正DFT误差。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/CrysLDNet.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/CrysLDNet.git 获取。

title_en: Latent Forcing: Reordering the Diffusion Trajectory for Pixel-Space Image Generation
title_zh: 潜在强迫：为像素空间图像生成重排扩散轨迹

sentences.en: Latent diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images but lose the benefits of end-to-end modeling.
sentences.zh: 潜在扩散模型擅长生成高质量图像，但失去了端到端建模的益处。

sentences.en: They discard information during image encoding, require a separately trained decoder, and model an auxiliary distribution to the raw data.
sentences.zh: 它们在图像编码过程中丢弃信息、需要单独训练的解码器，并对原始数据建模一个辅助分布。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Latent Forcing, a simple modification to existing architectures that achieves the efficiency of latent diffusion while operating on raw natural images.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出潜在强迫（Latent Forcing），一种对现有架构的简单修改，能够在处理原始自然图像的同时实现潜在扩散的效率。

sentences.en: Our approach orders the denoising trajectory by jointly processing latents and pixels with separately tuned noise schedules.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过联合处理潜在表示和像素（二者采用分别调优的噪声调度），对去噪轨迹进行排序。

sentences.en: This allows the latents to act as a scratchpad for intermediate computation before high-frequency pixel features are generated.
sentences.zh: 这使得潜在表示能够在高频像素特征生成之前充当中间计算的暂存区（scratchpad）。

sentences.en: We find that the order of conditioning signals is critical, and we analyze this to explain differences between REPA distillation in the tokenizer and the diffusion model, as well as conditional and unconditional generation.
sentences.zh: 我们发现条件信号的顺序至关重要，并对此进行分析以解释分词器与扩散模型之间REPA蒸馏的差异，以及条件生成与无条件生成之间的差异。

sentences.en: Applied to pixel-space diffusion on ImageNet, Latent Forcing achieves a new state of the art for diffusion transformer-based pixel generation at our compute scale.
sentences.zh: 将潜在强迫应用于ImageNet上的像素空间扩散，在我们所采用的计算规模下，它为基于扩散Transformer的像素生成树立了新的最先进水平。

sentences.en: Code and checkpoints at https://github.com/AlanBaade/LatentForcing
sentences.zh: 代码与检查点见 https://github.com/AlanBaade/LatentForcing。

title_en: Latent Guided Sampling for Combinatorial Optimization
title_zh: 用于组合优化的潜在引导采样

sentences.en: Combinatorial Optimization problems are widespread in domains such as logistics, manufacturing, and drug discovery, yet their NP-hard nature makes them computationally challenging.
sentences.zh: 组合优化问题广泛存在于物流、制造和药物发现等领域，然而其NP难性使其在计算上颇具挑战。

sentences.en: Recent Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) methods leverage deep learning to learn policies for constructing solutions, trained via Supervised or Reinforcement Learning.
sentences.zh: 近期的神经组合优化（NCO）方法利用深度学习来学习构造解的策略，并通过监督学习或强化学习进行训练。

sentences.en: While promising, these approaches often rely on task-specific augmentations, perform poorly on out-of-distribution instances, and lack robust inference mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 尽管前景看好，但这些方法往往依赖任务特定的增广，在分布外实例上表现不佳，且缺乏稳健的推理机制。

sentences.en: Moreover, existing latent space models either require labeled data or use an instance-independent latent distribution.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有的潜在空间模型要么需要标注数据，要么使用与实例无关的潜在分布。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose LGS-Net, a novel latent space model that conditions on problem instances, and introduce an efficient inference method, Latent Guided Sampling (LGS), based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo and Stochastic Approximation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出LGS-Net，一种以问题实例为条件的新颖潜在空间模型，并引入一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和随机近似的高效推理方法——潜在引导采样（LGS）。

sentences.en: We show that the iterations of our method form a time-inhomogeneous Markov Chain and provide rigorous theoretical convergence guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了该方法的迭代构成一个时间非齐次马尔可夫链，并提供了严格的理论收敛保证。

sentences.en: Empirical results on benchmark routing tasks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among NCO baselines.
sentences.zh: 在基准路径规划任务上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在NCO基线中达到了最先进的性能。
